sentences.zh: 志第二十六 禮四

translations.literal: Treatises 26: Rites 4
translations.idiomatic: Treatises 26: Rites 4

sentences.zh: （吉禮四）〉

translations.literal: (Auspicious Rites IV)
translations.idiomatic: (Auspicious Rites IV)

sentences.zh: 歷代帝王陵廟 三皇 聖師 國先師孔子 旗纛 五祀 國馬神南京神廟 功臣廟 京師九廟 諸神祠 厲壇

translations.literal: Tombs and temples of emperors through the ages; the Three Sovereigns; the Holy Teachers; the National Ancestral Teacher Confucius; banners and pennants; the Five Sacrifices; the National Horse God and Nanjing spirit temples; the Meritorious Ministers Temple; the Nine Temples of the capital; various spirit shrines; the altar of wandering ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: Tombs and temples of emperors through the ages; the Three Sovereigns; the Holy Teachers; the National Ancestral Teacher Confucius; banners and pennants; the Five Sacrifices; the National Horse God and Nanjing spirit temples; the Meritorious Ministers Temple; the Nine Temples of the capital; various spirit shrines; and the altar of wandering ghosts.

sentences.zh: ○歷代帝王陵廟

translations.literal: ○ Tombs and temples of emperors through the ages
translations.idiomatic: Tombs and Temples of Emperors Through the Ages

sentences.zh: 洪武三年，遣使訪先代陵寢，仍命各行省具圖以進，凡七十有九。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongwu, envoys were dispatched to seek out the mausoleums of former ages, and each provincial administration was also ordered to prepare maps and submit them; in all there were seventy-nine.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Hongwu reign, the court sent envoys to locate the mausoleums of earlier dynasties and ordered each provincial administration to submit maps of them; seventy-nine sites were found in all.

sentences.zh: 禮官考其功德昭著者，曰伏羲，神農，黃帝，少昊，顓頊，唐堯，虞舜，夏禹，商湯、中宗、高宗，周文王、武王、成王、康王，漢高祖、文帝、景帝、武帝、宣帝、光武、明帝、章帝，後魏文帝，隋高祖，唐高祖、太宗、憲宗、宣宗，周世宗，宋太祖、太宗、真宗、仁宗、孝宗、理宗，凡三十有六。

translations.literal: The ritual officials examined those whose merit and virtue were illustrious, naming Fuxi, Shennong, the Yellow Emperor, Shaohao, Zhuanxu, Tang Yao, Yu Shun, Yu of Xia, Tang of Shang, Zhongzong, and Gaozong, King Wen, King Wu, King Cheng, and King Kang of Zhou, Gaozu, Wendi, Jingdi, Wudi, Xuandi, Guangwu, Mingdi, and Zhangdi of Han, Wendi of Later Wei, Gaozu of Sui, Gaozu, Taizong, Xianzong, and Xuanzong of Tang, Shizong of Zhou, and Taizu, Taizong, Zhenzong, Renzong, Xiaozong, and Lizong of Song—in all thirty-six.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials identified thirty-six rulers whose achievements stood out clearly: Fuxi, Shennong, the Yellow Emperor, Shaohao, Zhuanxu, Tang Yao, Yu Shun, Yu of Xia, Tang of Shang along with Zhongzong and Gaozong, the Zhou kings Wen, Wu, Cheng, and Kang, the Han emperors Gaozu, Wen, Jing, Wu, Xuan, Guangwu, Ming, and Zhang, Emperor Wen of Later Wei, Emperor Gaozu of Sui, the Tang emperors Gaozu, Taizong, Xianzong, and Xuanzong, Emperor Shizong of Later Zhou, and the Song emperors Taizu, Taizong, Zhenzong, Renzong, Xiaozong, and Lizong.

sentences.zh: 各制袞冕，函香幣。

translations.literal: For each, investiture robes and caps were made, and incense and silks were placed in cases.
translations.idiomatic: For each site they prepared investiture robes and caps and cased offerings of incense and silk.

sentences.zh: 遣祕書監丞陶誼等往修祀禮，親制祝文遣之。

translations.literal: The Secretariat Supervisor Assistant Director Tao Yi and others were sent to restore the sacrificial rites, and the emperor personally composed prayer texts and dispatched them.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Yi, assistant director of the Secretariat Directorate, and others were sent to restore the sacrificial rites, and the emperor himself drafted the prayer texts they carried.

sentences.zh: 每陵以白金二十五兩具祭物。

translations.literal: For each mausoleum, twenty-five taels of white silver were provided to furnish the sacrificial goods.
translations.idiomatic: Each mausoleum was allotted twenty-five taels of silver to supply its sacrificial goods.

sentences.zh: 陵寢發者掩之，壞者完之。

translations.literal: Where the mausoleum mound had opened, it was covered over; where it was damaged, it was made whole.
translations.idiomatic: Exposed burial mounds were covered again, and damaged ones were repaired.

sentences.zh: 廟敝者葺之。

translations.literal: Temples that were dilapidated were rethatched.
translations.idiomatic: Dilapidated temples were rethatched.

sentences.zh: 無廟者設壇以祭。

translations.literal: Where there was no temple, an altar was set up for sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Where no temple existed, an altar was erected for sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 仍令有司禁樵採。

translations.literal: The local officials were also ordered to forbid cutting wood and gathering fuel.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials were also ordered to forbid logging and fuel gathering on the sites.

sentences.zh: 歲時祭祀，牲用太牢。

translations.literal: For the seasonal sacrifices throughout the year, the great offering was used.
translations.idiomatic: Seasonal sacrifices were to use the great offering of an ox, a sheep, and a pig.

sentences.zh: 四年，禮部定議，合祀帝王三十五。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the Ministry of Rites settled the deliberation: jointly to sacrifice to thirty-five emperors.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the Ministry of Rites finalized a plan to sacrifice jointly to thirty-five emperors.

sentences.zh: 在河南者十：陳祀伏羲、商高宗，孟津祀漢光武，洛陽祀漢明帝、章帝，鄭祀周世宗，鞏祀宋太祖、太宗、真宗、仁宗。

translations.literal: In Henan there were ten: at Chen, Fuxi and Gaozong of Shang; at Mengjin, Guangwu of Han; at Luoyang, Mingdi and Zhangdi of Han; at Zheng, Shizong of Zhou; at Gong, Taizu, Taizong, Zhenzong, and Renzong of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Ten were in Henan: Fuxi and Shang Gaozong at Chen, Han Guangwu at Mengjin, Han Mingdi and Zhangdi at Luoyang, Zhou Shizong at Zheng, and Song Taizu, Taizong, Zhenzong, and Renzong at Gong.

sentences.zh: 在山西者一：滎河祀商湯。

translations.literal: In Shanxi there was one: at Ronghe, Tang of Shang.
translations.idiomatic: One was in Shanxi: Tang of Shang at Ronghe.

sentences.zh: 在山東者二：東平祀唐堯，曲阜祀少昊。

translations.literal: In Shandong there were two: at Dongping, Tang Yao; at Qufu, Shaohao.
translations.idiomatic: Two were in Shandong: Tang Yao at Dongping and Shaohao at Qufu.

sentences.zh: 在北平者三：內黃祀商中宗，滑祀顓頊、高辛。

translations.literal: In Beiping there were three: at Neihuang, Zhongzong of Shang; at Hua, Zhuanxu and Gaoxin.
translations.idiomatic: Three were in Beiping: Shang Zhongzong at Neihuang and Zhuanxu and Gaoxin at Hua.

sentences.zh: 在湖廣者二：酃祀神農，甯遠祀虞舜。

translations.literal: In Huguang there were two: at Ling, Shennong; at Ningyuan, Yu Shun.
translations.idiomatic: Two were in Huguang: Shennong at Ling and Yu Shun at Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 在浙江者二：會稽祀夏禹、宋孝宗。

translations.literal: In Zhejiang there were two: at Kuaiji, Yu of Xia and Xiaozong of Song.
translations.idiomatic: Two were in Zhejiang: Yu of Xia and Song Xiaozong at Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 在陝西者十五：中部祀黃帝，咸陽祀周文王、武王、成王、康王、宣王，漢高帝、景帝，鹹甯祀漢文帝，興平祀漢武帝，長安祀漢宣帝，三原祀唐高祖，醴泉祀唐太宗，蒲城祀唐憲宗，涇陽祀唐宣宗。

translations.literal: In Shaanxi there were fifteen: at Zhongbu, the Yellow Emperor; at Xianyang, King Wen, King Wu, King Cheng, King Kang, and King Xuan of Zhou, Gaodi and Jingdi of Han; at Xianning, Wendi of Han; at Xingping, Wudi of Han; at Chang'an, Xuandi of Han; at Sanyuan, Gaozu of Tang; at Liquan, Taizong of Tang; at Pucheng, Xianzong of Tang; at Jingyang, Xuanzong of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen were in Shaanxi: the Yellow Emperor at Zhongbu; the Zhou kings Wen, Wu, Cheng, Kang, and Xuan together with Han Gaodi and Jingdi at Xianyang; Han Wendi at Xianning; Han Wudi at Xingping; Han Xuandi at Chang'an; Tang Gaozu at Sanyuan; Tang Taizong at Liquan; Tang Xianzong at Pucheng; and Tang Xuanzong at Jingyang.

sentences.zh: 歲祭用仲春、仲秋朔。

translations.literal: The annual sacrifices were held on the first day of the second month of spring and the second month of autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Annual sacrifices were held on the first day of the second month of spring and of autumn.

sentences.zh: 於是遣使詣各陵致祭。

translations.literal: Thereupon envoys were dispatched to each mausoleum to perform the sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were then sent to each mausoleum to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 陵置一碑，刊祭期及牲帛之數，俾所在有司守之。

translations.literal: At each mausoleum a stele was set up, inscribing the sacrificial schedule and the quantities of victims and silks, so that the local officials there might observe it.
translations.idiomatic: Each mausoleum received a stele recording the schedule of sacrifices and the quantities of victims and silk, which local officials were to follow.

sentences.zh: 已而命有司歲時修葺，設陵戶二人守視。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward the local officials were ordered to repair the sites seasonally, and two mausoleum households were established to guard and watch over them.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward local officials were ordered to maintain the sites each year, and two mausoleum households were assigned to guard each one.

sentences.zh: 又每三年，出祝文、香帛，傳制遣太常寺樂舞生齎往所在，命有司致祭。

translations.literal: Moreover, every three years prayer texts and incense and silks were issued, and by imperial rescript musicians and dancers of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices were sent bearing them to each place, with orders to the local officials to perform the sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Every three years the court also issued prayer texts, incense, and silk and, by imperial rescript, sent musicians and dancers from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to each site with orders for local officials to conduct the rites.

sentences.zh: 其所祀者，視前去周宣王，漢明帝、章帝，而增祀媧皇於趙城，後魏文帝於富平，元世祖於順天，及宋理宗於會稽，凡三十六帝。

translations.literal: Those sacrificed to, compared with the previous list, removed King Xuan of Zhou and Mingdi and Zhangdi of Han, while adding the Empress Nuwa at Zhaocheng, Wendi of Later Wei at Fuping, Shizu of Yuan at Shuntian, and Lizong of Song at Kuaiji—in all thirty-six emperors.
translations.idiomatic: Compared with the earlier list, King Xuan of Zhou and the Han emperors Ming and Zhang were dropped, while Empress Nuwa at Zhaocheng, Later Wei Emperor Wen at Fuping, the Yuan founder at Shuntian, and Song Lizong at Kuaiji were added, for thirty-six rulers in all.

sentences.zh: 後又增祀隋高祖於扶風，而理宗仍罷祀。

translations.literal: Later Gaozu of Sui was added at Fufeng, while Lizong's sacrifice was again abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Later Sui Gaozu was added at Fufeng, while Lizong was again removed from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 又命帝王陵廟所在官司，以春秋仲月上旬，擇日致祭。

translations.literal: It was also ordered that the offices where imperial tombs and temples stood should, in the first ten days of the second month of spring and autumn, choose a day to perform the sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Offices responsible for imperial tombs and temples were also told to choose a day within the first ten days of the second month of spring and autumn for the sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 六年，帝以五帝、三王及漢、唐、宋創業之君，俱宜於京師立廟致祭，遂建歷代帝王廟於欽天山之陽。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the emperor held that the Five Emperors, the Three Kings, and the founding rulers of Han, Tang, and Song were all fit to have temples established in the capital for sacrifice, and so the Temple of Emperors Through the Ages was built on the southern slope of Qintian Hill.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the emperor decided that the Five Emperors, the Three Kings, and the founding rulers of Han, Tang, and Song should all receive temples in the capital, and he built the Temple of Emperors Through the Ages on the southern slope of Qintian Hill.

sentences.zh: 仿太廟同堂異室之制，為正殿五室：中一室三皇，東一室五帝，西一室夏禹、商湯、周文王，又東一室周武王、漢光武、唐太宗，又西一室漢高祖、唐太祖、宋太祖、元世祖。

translations.literal: Following the Grand Temple's system of one hall with separate chambers, the main hall had five chambers: the central chamber for the Three Sovereigns; the eastern chamber for the Five Emperors; the western chamber for Yu of Xia, Tang of Shang, and King Wen of Zhou; a further eastern chamber for King Wu of Zhou, Guangwu of Han, and Taizong of Tang; and a further western chamber for Gaozu of Han, Taizu of Tang, Taizu of Song, and Shizu of Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Following the Grand Temple model of one hall with separate chambers, the main hall had five rooms: the Three Sovereigns in the center, the Five Emperors to the east, Yu of Xia, Tang of Shang, and King Wen of Zhou to the west, King Wu of Zhou, Han Guangwu, and Tang Taizong in the chamber beyond the east, and Han Gaozu, Tang Taizu, Song Taizu, and the Yuan founder in the chamber beyond the west.

sentences.zh: 每歲春秋仲月上旬甲日致祭。

translations.literal: Each year sacrifices were performed on a jia day in the first ten days of the second month of spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices were held each year on a jia day within the first ten days of the second month of spring and of autumn.

sentences.zh: 已而以周文王終守臣服，唐高祖由太宗得天下，遂寢其祀，增祀隋高祖。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward, because King Wen of Zhou to the end kept the posture of a subject in service, and because Gaozu of Tang obtained the realm through Taizong, their sacrifices were suspended and Gaozu of Sui was added.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward King Wen of Zhou was dropped because he had remained a subject to the end, and Tang Gaozu was dropped because his son Taizong had won the realm; Sui Gaozu was added in their place.

sentences.zh: 七年，令帝王廟皆塑袞冕坐像，惟伏羲、神農未有衣裳之制，不必加冕服。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, it was ordered that in all imperial temples seated images in investiture robes and caps should be molded; only Fuxi and Shennong had no established garment system, so they need not be given caps and robes.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year every imperial temple was ordered to install seated statues in full investiture dress, except that Fuxi and Shennong, for whom no formal garments were prescribed, were not given caps and robes.

sentences.zh: 八月，帝躬祀於新廟。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the emperor personally sacrificed at the new temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the emperor sacrificed in person at the new temple.

sentences.zh: 已而罷隋高祖之祀。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward the sacrifice to Gaozu of Sui was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Sui Gaozu was removed from the sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，令每歲郊祀，附祭歷代帝王於大祀殿。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year it was ordered that at each year's suburban sacrifice, emperors through the ages should be sacrificed to as an appended rite in the Great Sacrifice Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the court ordered that each year's suburban sacrifice include a supplementary offering to emperors through the ages in the Great Sacrifice Hall.

sentences.zh: 仍以歲八月中旬，擇日遣官祭於本廟，其春祭停之。

translations.literal: Still, in the middle ten days of the eighth month each year a day was chosen and officials dispatched to sacrifice at the original temple; the spring sacrifice was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were still sent on a chosen day in the middle ten days of the eighth month to sacrifice at the main temple, while the spring rite was discontinued.

sentences.zh: 又定每三年遣祭各陵之歲，則停廟祭。

translations.literal: It was also fixed that in the years when envoys were sent every three years to sacrifice at each mausoleum, the temple sacrifice should be suspended.
translations.idiomatic: It was also ruled that in years when the triennial missions to the individual mausoleums took place, the temple sacrifice would be omitted.

sentences.zh: 是年，詔以歷代名臣從祀，禮官李原名奏擬三十六人以進。

translations.literal: That year an edict ordered famous ministers through the ages to receive accompanying sacrifice; the ritual official Li Yuanming memorialized with a proposed list of thirty-six persons and submitted it.
translations.idiomatic: That year an edict called for famous ministers through the ages to receive accompanying sacrifice, and the ritual official Li Yuanming submitted a list of thirty-six candidates.

sentences.zh: 帝以宋趙普負太祖不忠，不可從祀。

translations.literal: The emperor held that Zhao Pu of Song had been disloyal to Taizu and could not receive accompanying sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ruled that Song's Zhao Pu, having betrayed Taizu, could not be included.

sentences.zh: 元臣四傑，木華黎為首，不可祀孫而去其祖，可祀木華黎而罷安童。

translations.literal: Among the Yuan ministers, the Four Outstanding Ones had Muqali at their head; one could not sacrifice to the grandson while removing the grandfather—Muqali could be sacrificed to and Antong abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Of the Yuan's four great ministers, Muqali stood first; one could not honor the grandson while omitting the grandfather, so Muqali was to be included and Antong dropped.

sentences.zh: 既祀伯顏，則阿術不必祀。

translations.literal: Since Bayan was to be sacrificed to, A'erzhu need not be.
translations.idiomatic: If Bayan was to be honored, A'erzhu need not be.

sentences.zh: 漢陳平、馮異，宋潘美，皆善始終，可祀。

translations.literal: Chen Ping and Feng Yi of Han and Pan Mei of Song all had good beginnings and ends and could be sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ping and Feng Yi of Han and Pan Mei of Song had all served well from start to finish and were approved for inclusion.

sentences.zh: 於是定風後、力牧、皋陶、夔、龍、伯夷、伯益、伊尹、傅說、周公旦、召公奭、太公望、召虎、方叔、張良、蕭何、曹參、陳平、周勃、鄧禹、馮異、諸葛亮、房玄齡、杜如晦、李靖、郭子儀、李晟、曹彬、潘美、韓世忠、岳飛、張浚、木華黎、博爾忽、博爾術、赤老溫、伯顏，凡三十七人，從祀於東西廡，為壇四。

translations.literal: Thereupon were fixed Feng Hou, Li Mu, Gao Yao, Kui, Long, Boyi, Bo Yi, Yi Yin, Fu Yue, the Duke of Zhou, the Duke of Shao, Taigong Wang, Duke Hu of Shao, Fang Shu, Zhang Liang, Xiao He, Cao Can, Chen Ping, Zhou Bo, Deng Yu, Feng Yi, Zhuge Liang, Fang Xuanling, Du Ruhui, Li Jing, Guo Ziyi, Li Sheng, Cao Bin, Pan Mei, Han Shizhong, Yue Fei, Zhang Jun, Muqali, Bo'erhu, Bo'ershu, Chilaowen, and Bayan—in all thirty-seven persons—to receive accompanying sacrifice in the eastern and western side halls, arranged in four altars.
translations.idiomatic: The court then fixed thirty-seven accompanying figures—Feng Hou, Li Mu, Gao Yao, Kui, Long, Boyi, Bo Yi, Yi Yin, Fu Yue, the Duke of Zhou, the Duke of Shao, Taigong Wang, Duke Hu of Shao, Fang Shu, Zhang Liang, Xiao He, Cao Can, Chen Ping, Zhou Bo, Deng Yu, Feng Yi, Zhuge Liang, Fang Xuanling, Du Ruhui, Li Jing, Guo Ziyi, Li Sheng, Cao Bin, Pan Mei, Han Shizhong, Yue Fei, Zhang Jun, Muqali, Bo'erhu, Bo'ershu, Chilaowen, and Bayan—honored in the eastern and western side halls on four altars.

sentences.zh: 初，太公望有武成王廟。

translations.literal: At first Taigong Wang had a Temple of the Martial Completion King.
translations.idiomatic: Taigong Wang had originally possessed his own Temple of the Martial Completion King.

sentences.zh: 嘗遣官致祭如釋奠儀。

translations.literal: Officials had once been dispatched to sacrifice according to the libation-and-offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: Officials had once been sent to sacrifice there with the same rites used for the libation ceremony.

sentences.zh: 至是，罷廟祭，去王號。

translations.literal: At this point the temple sacrifice was abolished and the kingly title removed.
translations.idiomatic: Now that separate temple was abolished and his royal title was dropped.

sentences.zh: 永樂遷都，帝王廟遣南京太常寺官行禮。

translations.literal: When Yongle moved the capital, sacrifice at the Temple of Emperors was entrusted to officials of the Nanjing Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: After Yongle moved the capital, Nanjing officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices continued to perform the rites at the imperial temple.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖九年，罷歷代帝王南郊從祀。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Jiajing, the appended sacrifice to emperors through the ages at the southern suburban altar was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Jiajing the supplementary offering to emperors through the ages at the southern suburban altar was abolished.

sentences.zh: 令建歷代帝王廟於都城西，歲以仲春秋致祭。

translations.literal: It was ordered to build the Temple of Emperors Through the Ages west of the capital, with sacrifices each year in the second month of spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: A new Temple of Emperors Through the Ages was ordered west of the capital, with sacrifices each year in the second month of spring and of autumn.

sentences.zh: 後並罷南京廟祭。

translations.literal: Later the Nanjing temple sacrifice was also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Nanjing temple sacrifices were discontinued as well.

sentences.zh: 十年春二月，廟未成，躬祭歷代帝王於文華殿，凡五壇，丹陛東西名臣四壇。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring in the tenth year, before the temple was completed, he personally sacrificed to emperors through the ages in the Wenhua Hall—five altars in all, with four altars for famous ministers to east and west of the cinnabar steps.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring in the tenth year, before the new temple was finished, the emperor sacrificed in person to emperors through the ages in Wenhua Hall on five altars, with four more altars for famous ministers flanking the red steps east and west.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書李時言：「舊儀有賜福胙之文。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Li Shi said: "The old rites contain language of bestowing blessing and sacrificial meat.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Li Shi said, "The old rites speak of bestowing blessing and sacrificial meat.

sentences.zh: 賜者自上而下之義，惟郊廟社稷宜用。

translations.literal: Bestowal carries the meaning of from above to below; only the suburban altar, temples, and altars of soil and grain should use it.
translations.idiomatic: Bestowal implies a gift from above, and only the suburban altar, state temples, and altars of soil and grain should use that wording.

sentences.zh: 歷代帝王，止宜雲答。

translations.literal: For emperors through the ages, one should only say 'reply.'"
translations.idiomatic: For emperors through the ages, the text should simply say 'reply.'"

sentences.zh: 」詔可。

translations.literal: " An edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the change.

sentences.zh: 十一年夏，廟成，名曰景德崇聖之殿。

translations.literal: In the summer of the eleventh year the temple was completed, named the Hall of Revering Virtue and Honoring the Sages.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the eleventh year the temple was finished and named the Hall of Revering Virtue and Honoring the Sages.

sentences.zh: 殿五室，東西兩廡，殿後祭器庫，前為景德門。

translations.literal: The hall had five chambers, with eastern and western side halls; behind the hall was a repository for sacrificial vessels; in front was the Jingde Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The hall had five chambers with side halls to east and west, a repository for ritual vessels behind it, and the Jingde Gate in front.

sentences.zh: 門外神庫、神廚、宰牲亭、鐘樓。

translations.literal: Outside the gate were the spirit repository, spirit kitchen, slaughter pavilion, and bell tower.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the gate stood the spirit repository, spirit kitchen, slaughter pavilion, and bell tower.

sentences.zh: 街東西二坊，曰景德街。

translations.literal: To east and west of the street were two wards, called Jingde Street.
translations.idiomatic: Two wards flanked the street, which was called Jingde Street.

sentences.zh: 用八月壬辰親祭。

translations.literal: On the renchen day of the eighth month he sacrificed in person.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the eighth month he sacrificed in person.

sentences.zh: 帝由中門入，迎神、受福胙、送神各兩拜。

translations.literal: The emperor entered by the central gate; for welcoming the spirits, receiving blessing and sacrificial meat, and sending off the spirits, he performed two obeisances each.
translations.idiomatic: He entered through the central gate and made two obeisances each for welcoming the spirits, receiving the blessing and sacrificial meat, and sending the spirits away.

sentences.zh: 嗣後歲遣大臣一員行禮，四員分獻。

translations.literal: Thereafter each year one great minister was dispatched to perform the rite, with four ministers making divided offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In later years one senior minister performed the rite each year, assisted by four others who made the divided offerings.

sentences.zh: 凡子、午、卯、酉祭於陵寢之歲，則停秋祭。

translations.literal: Whenever it was a zi, wu, mao, or you year for sacrificing at the mausoleums, the autumn sacrifice was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In years of the zi, wu, mao, and you cycles when sacrifices were sent to the mausoleums, the autumn temple rite was omitted.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，以禮科陳棐言，罷元世祖陵廟之祀，及從祀木華黎等，復遷唐太宗與宋太祖同室。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, on the memorial of Chen Fei of the Rites Section, sacrifice at the mausoleum and temple of Shizu of Yuan was abolished, as was the accompanying sacrifice to Muqali and others; Taizong of Tang was again moved to share a chamber with Taizu of Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, on a memorial from Chen Fei of the Rites Section, the Yuan founder's mausoleum and temple sacrifices were abolished, Muqali and others were removed from the accompanying rolls, and Tang Taizong was again placed in the same chamber as Song Taizu.

sentences.zh: 凡十五帝，從祀名臣三十二人。

translations.literal: In all there were fifteen emperors and thirty-two famous ministers in accompanying sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen emperors and thirty-two famous ministers were honored in all.

sentences.zh: ○三皇

translations.literal: ○ The Three Sovereigns
translations.idiomatic: The Three Sovereigns

sentences.zh: 明初仍元制，以三月三日、九月九日通祀三皇。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming the Yuan system was retained, sacrificing universally to the Three Sovereigns on the third day of the third month and the ninth day of the ninth month.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the dynasty the court kept the Yuan practice of offering universal sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns on the third day of the third month and the ninth day of the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，令乙太牢祀。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu it was ordered to use the yi day and the great offering for sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu the court ordered sacrifices on yi days with the great offering.

sentences.zh: 二年，命以句芒、祝融、風後、力牧左右配，俞跗、桐君、僦貸季、少師、雷公、鬼臾區、伯高、岐伯、少俞、高陽十大名醫從祀。

translations.literal: In the second year it was ordered that Gou Mang, Zhu Rong, Feng Hou, and Li Mu should be paired to left and right, and that Yu Fu, Tong Jun, Ji Daiji, Shaoshi, Lei Gong, Gui Yuju, Bo Gao, Qi Bo, Shao Yu, and Gaoyang—the ten great physicians—should receive accompanying sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Gou Mang, Zhu Rong, Feng Hou, and Li Mu were appointed as left and right associates, and ten celebrated physicians—Yu Fu, Tong Jun, Ji Daiji, Shaoshi, Lei Gong, Gui Yuju, Bo Gao, Qi Bo, Shao Yu, and Gaoyang—were added as accompanying figures.

sentences.zh: 儀同釋奠。

translations.literal: The rites were the same as the libation-and-offering ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony followed the same rites as the libation offering.

sentences.zh: 四年，帝以天下郡邑通祀三皇為瀆。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the emperor held that universal sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns in every commandery and county was an excess.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the emperor declared that universal county and prefectural sacrifice to the Three Sovereigns was an abuse of ritual.

sentences.zh: 禮臣議：「唐玄宗嘗立三皇五帝廟於京師。

translations.literal: The ritual officials deliberated: "Emperor Xuanzong of Tang once established a temple to the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials argued, "Emperor Xuanzong of Tang once built a temple to the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors in the capital.

sentences.zh: 至元成宗時，乃立三皇廟於府州縣。

translations.literal: Only in the time of Chengzong of Yuan were temples to the Three Sovereigns established in prefectures, subprefectures, and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Only under Yuan Chengzong were Three Sovereigns temples spread through prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 春秋通祀，而以醫藥主之，甚非禮也。

translations.literal: They were sacrificed to universally in spring and autumn, yet medicine and pharmacy presided over them—this is greatly contrary to ritual."
translations.idiomatic: Spring and autumn brought universal sacrifice, yet the rites were run by medical officials—this is far from proper ritual."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰： 「三皇繼天立極，開萬世教化之原，汨於藥師可乎？

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "The Three Sovereigns succeeded Heaven and established the pole, opening the source of teaching for ten thousand generations—can they be debased to pharmacists?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied, "The Three Sovereigns succeeded Heaven and set the cosmic pole, opening the source of civilization for ten thousand generations—can they be reduced to patron saints of pharmacy?"

sentences.zh: 」命天下郡縣毋得褻祀。

translations.literal: " He ordered that commanderies and counties throughout the realm must not perform irreverent sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered every commandery and county to cease such improper sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 正德十一年，立伏羲氏廟於秦州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhengde a temple to Fuxi was established at Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Zhengde a temple to Fuxi was built at Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 秦州，古成紀地，從巡按御史馮時雄奏也。

translations.literal: Qinzhou was the ancient land of Chengji, following the memorial of touring censor Feng Shixiong.
translations.idiomatic: Qinzhou was the ancient territory of Chengji; the project followed a memorial from touring censor Feng Shixiong.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖間，建三皇廟於太醫院北，名景惠殿。

translations.literal: During the Jiajing reign a temple to the Three Sovereigns was built north of the Imperial Medical Academy, named the Jinghui Hall.
translations.idiomatic: During Jiajing a Three Sovereigns temple was built north of the Imperial Medical Academy and named the Jinghui Hall.

sentences.zh: 中奉三皇及四配。

translations.literal: In the center were enshrined the Three Sovereigns and four associates.
translations.idiomatic: The central shrine honored the Three Sovereigns with four associates.

sentences.zh: 其從祀，東廡則僦貸季、岐伯、伯高、鬼臾區、俞跗、少俞、少師、桐君、雷公、馬師皇、伊尹、扁鵲、淳于意、張機十四人，西廡則華陀、王叔和、皇甫謐、葛洪、巢元方、孫思邈、韋慈藏、王冰、錢乙、硃肱、李杲、利完素、張元素、硃彥修十四人。

translations.literal: For accompanying sacrifice, the eastern side hall had Ji Daiji, Qi Bo, Bo Gao, Gui Yuju, Yu Fu, Shao Yu, Shaoshi, Tong Jun, Lei Gong, Mashihuang, Yi Yin, Bian Que, Chunyu Yi, and Zhang Ji—fourteen persons; the western side hall had Hua Tuo, Wang Shuhe, Huangfu Mi, Ge Hong, Chao Yuanfang, Sun Simiao, Wei Cizang, Wang Bing, Qian Yi, Zhu Gong, Li Gao, Li Wansu, Zhang Yuansu, and Zhu Yanxiu—fourteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern side hall honored fourteen accompanying figures—Ji Daiji, Qi Bo, Bo Gao, Gui Yuju, Yu Fu, Shao Yu, Shaoshi, Tong Jun, Lei Gong, Mashihuang, Yi Yin, Bian Que, Chunyu Yi, and Zhang Ji—while the western side hall honored fourteen others: Hua Tuo, Wang Shuhe, Huangfu Mi, Ge Hong, Chao Yuanfang, Sun Simiao, Wei Cizang, Wang Bing, Qian Yi, Zhu Gong, Li Gao, Li Wansu, Zhang Yuansu, and Zhu Yanxiu.

sentences.zh: 歲仲春、秋上甲日，禮部堂上官行禮，太醫院堂上官二員分獻，用少牢。

translations.literal: Each year on the first jia day of the second month of spring and autumn, a chief official of the Ministry of Rites performed the rite, with two chief officials of the Imperial Medical Academy making divided offerings, using the lesser offering.
translations.idiomatic: On the first jia day of the second month of spring and of autumn each year, a chief Ministry of Rites official led the rite, two chief Imperial Medical Academy officials made the divided offerings, and the lesser offering was used.

sentences.zh: 復建聖濟殿於內，祀先醫，以太醫官主之。

translations.literal: Within it the Shengji Hall was also built to sacrifice to the former physicians, presided over by imperial medical officials.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the complex a Shengji Hall was also built to honor the ancient physicians under the charge of imperial medical officials.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，帝以規制湫隘，命拓其廟。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the emperor, because the layout was cramped and narrow, ordered the temple expanded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the emperor found the layout too cramped and ordered the temple enlarged.

sentences.zh: ○聖師

translations.literal: ○ The Holy Teachers
translations.idiomatic: The Holy Teachers

sentences.zh: 聖師之祭，始於世宗。

translations.literal: Sacrifice to the Holy Teachers began with Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice to the Holy Teachers began under Emperor Shizong.

sentences.zh: 奉皇師伏羲氏、神農氏、軒轅氏、帝師陶唐氏，有虞氏，王師夏禹王、商湯王、周文王武王，九聖南向。

translations.literal: Enshrined as Imperial Teachers facing south were Fuxi, Shennong, and Xuanyuan; as Imperial Teachers, Yao of Taotang and Shun of Youyu; as Royal Teachers, King Yu of Xia, King Tang of Shang, and Kings Wen and Wu of Zhou—nine sages facing south.
translations.idiomatic: Nine sages faced south as Imperial Teachers Fuxi, Shennong, and Xuanyuan; as Imperial Teachers Yao of Taotang and Shun of Youyu; and as Royal Teachers King Yu of Xia, King Tang of Shang, and Kings Wen and Wu of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 左先聖周公，右先師孔子，東西向。

translations.literal: To the left was the Former Sage the Duke of Zhou; to the right was the Former Teacher Confucius—both facing east and west.
translations.idiomatic: The Former Sage, the Duke of Zhou, stood to the left facing east, and the Former Teacher, Confucius, to the right facing west.

sentences.zh: 每歲春秋開講前一日，皇帝服皮弁，拜跪，行釋奠禮。

translations.literal: Each year on the day before the spring and autumn lectures opened, the emperor wore the deerskin cap, bowed and knelt, and performed the libation-and-offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: On the day before the spring and autumn lecture seasons opened each year, the emperor wore the deerskin cap, bowed and knelt, and performed the libation ceremony.

sentences.zh: 用羹酒果脯帛祭於文華殿東室。

translations.literal: Using broth, wine, fruit, dried meat, and silks he sacrificed in the eastern chamber of the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He offered broth, wine, fruit, dried meat, and silk in the eastern chamber of Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 初，東室有釋像，帝以其不經，撤之，乃祀先聖先師。

translations.literal: At first the eastern chamber had a Buddhist image; the emperor, holding it uncanonical, removed it and then sacrificed to the Former Sage and Former Teacher.
translations.idiomatic: The eastern chamber had originally held a Buddhist image, which the emperor removed as improper before instituting sacrifice to the Former Sage and Former Teacher.

sentences.zh: 自為祭文，行奉安神位禮。

translations.literal: He himself composed the sacrificial text and performed the rite of installing and settling the spirit tablets.
translations.idiomatic: He composed the sacrificial text himself and performed the rite of installing the spirit tablets.

sentences.zh: 輔臣禮卿及講官俟行禮訖，入拜。

translations.literal: Supporting ministers, ritual ministers, and lecture officials waited until the rite was finished, then entered to bow.
translations.idiomatic: Supporting ministers, ritual officials, and lecture officers entered to bow only after the emperor had finished the rite.

sentences.zh: 先是洪武初，司業宋濂建議欲如建安熊氏之說，以伏羲為道統之宗，神農、黃帝、堯、舜、禹、湯、文、武，以次列焉。

translations.literal: Earlier, at the beginning of Hongwu, Vice Director Song Lian had proposed, following the theory of Xiong of Jian'an, to take Fuxi as the patriarch of the transmission of the Way, with Shennong, the Yellow Emperor, Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu arranged in sequence.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, at the start of Hongwu, Vice Director Song Lian had proposed, following Xiong of Jian'an, to place Fuxi at the head of the lineage of the Way and rank Shennong, the Yellow Emperor, Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu in succession after him.

sentences.zh: 秩祀天子之學，則道統益尊。

translations.literal: If ranked for sacrifice in the Son of Heaven's academy, then the transmission of the Way would be still more honored.
translations.idiomatic: If they were honored in ranked sacrifice at the Son of Heaven's academy, the lineage of the Way would stand higher still.

sentences.zh: 太祖不從。

translations.literal: Taizu did not follow it.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu did not accept the proposal.

sentences.zh: 至是，世宗仿其意行之。

translations.literal: At this point Shizong followed his meaning and carried it out.
translations.idiomatic: At that point Emperor Shizong adopted the proposal and put it into practice.

sentences.zh: 十六年，移祀於永明殿後，行禮如初。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year sacrifice was moved behind the Yongming Hall, and the rites were performed as at first.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year the rites were moved to a shrine behind Yongming Hall and conducted as before.

sentences.zh: 其後常遣官代祭。

translations.literal: Thereafter officials were regularly dispatched to sacrifice in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward officials were regularly sent to perform the sacrifices on his behalf.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，仍於文華殿東室行禮。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longqing the rites were again performed in the eastern chamber of the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Longqing reign the ceremony was again held in the eastern chamber of Wenhua Hall.

translations.literal: Section break.
translations.idiomatic: Section divider.

sentences.zh: ○至聖先師子孔廟祀

translations.literal: ○ Sacrifice at the Temple of the Most Sage and Former Teacher, Master Kong
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice at the Temple of the Most Sage and Former Teacher, Master Kong

sentences.zh: 漢晉及隋或稱先師，或稱先聖、宣尼、宣父。

translations.literal: In Han, Jin, and Sui he was sometimes called Former Teacher, sometimes Former Sage, Xuan Ni, or Xuan Fu.
translations.idiomatic: Under Han, Jin, and Sui he was styled at times Former Teacher, at times Former Sage, Xuan Ni, or Xuan Fu.

sentences.zh: 唐諡文宣王，宋加至聖號，元復加號大成。

translations.literal: Tang posthumously titled him King of Literary Propagation; Song added the title Most Sage; Yuan again added the title Great Completion.
translations.idiomatic: Tang gave him the posthumous title King of Literary Propagation; Song added Most Sage; Yuan added Great Completion.

sentences.zh: 明太祖入江淮府，首謁孔子廟。

translations.literal: When Ming Taizu entered Jianghuai Prefecture, he first paid homage at the Temple of Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu entered Jianghuai Prefecture, his first act was to visit the Temple of Confucius.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年二月，詔乙太牢祀孔子於國學，仍遣使詣曲阜致祭。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Hongwu an edict ordered sacrifice to Confucius at the National Academy on a yi day with the great offering, and still dispatched envoys to Qufu to perform sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Hongwu the court ordered sacrifice to Confucius at the National Academy on a yi day with the great offering and also sent envoys to perform the rites at Qufu.

sentences.zh: 臨行諭曰：「仲尼之道，廣大悠久，與天地並。

translations.literal: On departure he instructed them, saying: "The Way of Zhong Ni is vast, great, and long-enduring, standing alongside Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Before they departed he instructed them, "The Way of Zhong Ni is vast and enduring, standing alongside Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 有天下者莫不虔修祀事。

translations.literal: Whoever possesses the realm none fails devoutly to maintain the sacrificial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Every ruler who holds the realm devoutly maintains his sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 朕為天下主，期大明教化，以行先聖之道。

translations.literal: I as lord of the realm look to make bright the great transformation, in order to practice the Way of the Former Sage.
translations.idiomatic: As lord of the realm I intend to bring the great transformation to full light and walk in the Way of the Former Sage.

sentences.zh: 今既釋奠成均，仍遣爾修祀事於闕裡，爾其敬之。

translations.literal: Now that the libation offering has been performed at the Imperial Academy, I still dispatch you to carry out the sacrificial affairs at Que Li—be reverent in this."
translations.idiomatic: Now that the libation has been offered at the Imperial Academy, I still send you to conduct the rites at Que Li. Perform them with reverence."

sentences.zh: 」又定制，每歲仲春、秋上丁，皇帝降香，遣官祀於國學。

translations.literal: " Regulations were also fixed: each year on the first ding day of the second month of spring and autumn, the emperor sent down incense and dispatched officials to sacrifice at the National Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations were also fixed: on the first ding day of the second month of spring and of autumn each year, the emperor sent down incense and dispatched officials to sacrifice at the National Academy.

sentences.zh: 以丞相初獻，翰林學士亞獻，國子祭酒終獻。

translations.literal: The chancellor made the primary offering, a Hanlin academician the secondary offering, and the director of the Directorate of Education the final offering.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor made the primary offering, a Hanlin academician the secondary offering, and the director of the Directorate of Education the final offering.

sentences.zh: 先期，皇帝齋戒。

translations.literal: In advance the emperor fasted and purified himself.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor observed ritual purification in advance.

sentences.zh: 獻官、陪祀、執事官皆散齋二日，致齋一日。

translations.literal: The offering officials, those attending sacrifice, and the officiating officials all observed dispersed fasting for two days and concentrated fasting for one day.
translations.idiomatic: Offering officials, attendants, and officiants all observed two days of dispersed fasting and one day of concentrated fasting.

sentences.zh: 前祀一日，皇帝服皮弁服，禦奉天殿降香。

translations.literal: One day before the sacrifice the emperor wore the deerskin cap and robe, proceeded to the Hall of Supreme Harmony, and sent down incense.
translations.idiomatic: On the day before the sacrifice the emperor wore the deerskin cap and robe and proceeded to the Hall of Supreme Harmony to send down incense.

sentences.zh: 至日，獻官行禮。

translations.literal: On the day of the rite the offering officials performed the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of the rite the offering officials performed the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 三年，詔革諸神封號，惟孔子封爵仍舊。

translations.literal: In the third year an edict abolished the enfeoffed titles of all spirits; only Confucius's enfeoffment and title remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year an edict abolished the enfeoffed titles of all spirits, leaving only Confucius's titles unchanged.

sentences.zh: 且命曲阜廟庭，歲官給牲幣，俾衍聖公供祀事。

translations.literal: It was also ordered that at the temple courtyard in Qufu, each year officials should supply victims and silks, enabling the Duke Who Extends Sageliness to furnish the sacrificial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The court also ordered that each year officials supply victims and silk for the Qufu temple so that the Duke Who Extends Sageliness could maintain the sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 四年，禮部奏定儀物。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the Ministry of Rites memorialized to fix the ritual vessels.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the Ministry of Rites submitted specifications for the ritual vessels.

sentences.zh: 改初制籩豆之八為十，籩用竹。

translations.literal: The initial regulation of eight platters and cups was changed to ten; the platters were made of bamboo.
translations.idiomatic: The original set of eight platters and cups was increased to ten, with bamboo platters.

sentences.zh: 其簠簋登鉶及豆初用木者，悉易以瓷。

translations.literal: The grain vessels, elevated trays, meat stands, and cups that at first were of wood were all replaced with porcelain.
translations.idiomatic: Grain vessels, elevated trays, meat stands, and cups that had been wood were all replaced with porcelain.

sentences.zh: 牲易以熟。

translations.literal: The victims were changed to cooked offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial animals were replaced with cooked offerings.

sentences.zh: 樂生六十人，舞生四十八人，引舞二人，凡一百一十人。

translations.literal: Sixty musicians, forty-eight dancers, and two lead dancers—in all one hundred and ten persons.
translations.idiomatic: There were sixty musicians, forty-eight dancers, and two lead dancers, one hundred and ten in all.

sentences.zh: 禮部請選京民之秀者充樂舞生，太祖曰：「樂舞乃學者事，況釋奠所以崇師，宜擇國子生及公卿子弟在學者，豫教肄之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites requested selecting outstanding capital residents to serve as music and dance students. Taizu said: "Music and dance are matters for scholars; moreover, the libation offering is meant to honor the teacher—one should choose students of the Directorate of Education and sons of nobles and high officials who are in study, and teach and drill them in advance."
translations.idiomatic: When the Ministry of Rites proposed selecting talented capital residents as music and dance students, Taizu replied, "Music and dance belong to scholars, and the libation honors the teacher. Choose students of the Directorate of Education and sons of nobles and high officials who are in training, and drill them in advance."

sentences.zh: 」五年，罷孟子配享。

translations.literal: " In the fifth year Mencius's paired sacrifice was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Mencius was removed from paired sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 逾年，帝曰：「孟子辨異端，辟邪說，發明孔子之道，配享如故。

translations.literal: The next year the emperor said: "Mencius distinguished heterodox teachings, repelled evil doctrines, and elucidated the Way of Confucius—his paired sacrifice should be as before."
translations.idiomatic: The following year the emperor said, "Mencius refuted heterodox teachings, drove off false doctrines, and clarified the Way of Confucius; restore his paired sacrifice."

sentences.zh: 」七年二月，上丁日食，改用仲丁。

translations.literal: " In the second month of the seventh year there was an eclipse on the first ding day, so the second ding day was used instead.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year an eclipse fell on the first ding day, so the rites were moved to the second ding day.

sentences.zh: 十五年，新建太學成。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the newly built Imperial Academy was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year the newly built Imperial Academy was completed.

sentences.zh: 廟在學東，中大成殿，左右兩廡，前大成門，門左右列戟二十四。

translations.literal: The temple stood east of the academy, with the Great Completion Hall in the center, side halls to left and right, the Great Completion Gate in front, and twenty-four halberds arrayed to left and right of the gate.
translations.idiomatic: The temple stood east of the academy, with the Great Completion Hall at the center, side halls to either side, the Great Completion Gate in front, and twenty-four halberds flanking the gate.

sentences.zh: 門外東為犧牲廚，西為祭器庫，又前為靈星門。

translations.literal: Outside the gate, to the east was the victim kitchen and to the west the sacrificial vessel storehouse; still farther forward was the Spirit Star Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the gate the victim kitchen stood to the east and the vessel storehouse to the west, with the Spirit Star Gate farther forward.

sentences.zh: 自經始以來，駕數臨視。

translations.literal: From the time work began, the imperial carriage had visited several times to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: From the start of construction the emperor had visited the site several times.

sentences.zh: 至是落成，遣官致祭。

translations.literal: At this point it was completed, and officials were dispatched to perform sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: When it was finished, officials were sent to perform the dedication sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 帝既親詣釋奠，又詔天下通祀孔子，並頒釋奠儀注。

translations.literal: The emperor had already gone in person to perform the libation offering, and also ordered universal sacrifice to Confucius throughout the realm, issuing the ritual regulations for the libation offering.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had already performed the libation in person and also ordered universal sacrifice to Confucius throughout the realm, promulgating the ritual regulations for the ceremony.

sentences.zh: 凡府州縣學，籩豆以八，器物牲牢，皆殺於國學。

translations.literal: For all prefectural, subprefectural, and county academies, platters and cups numbered eight; vessels, victims, and offerings were all reduced from those of the National Academy.
translations.idiomatic: At every prefectural and county academy eight platters and cups were used, and all vessels and offerings were scaled down from the National Academy standard.

sentences.zh: 三獻禮同，十哲兩廡一獻。

translations.literal: The three offerings followed the same rite; the Ten Wise Ones in the two side halls received one offering each.
translations.idiomatic: The threefold offering followed the same procedure, while the Ten Wise Ones in the side halls received a single offering each.

sentences.zh: 其祭，各以正官行之，有布政司則以布政司官，分獻則以本學儒職及老成儒士充之。

translations.literal: For the sacrifice, each place used its regular chief official; where there was a provincial administration commission, its official performed it; for divided offerings, local Confucian posts and seasoned Confucian scholars served.
translations.idiomatic: Each locality's chief official led the sacrifice, or the provincial administration commissioner where one existed; divided offerings were made by local Confucian officers and senior scholars.

sentences.zh: 每歲春、秋仲月上丁日行事。

translations.literal: Each year the rite was performed on the first ding day of the second month of spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: The rite was held each year on the first ding day of the second month of spring and of autumn.

sentences.zh: 初，國學主祭遣祭酒，後遣翰林院官，然祭酒初到官，必遣一祭。

translations.literal: At first the National Academy's chief sacrifice was entrusted to the director of education; later a Hanlin Academy official was dispatched, yet when a director first took office, one sacrifice was always sent.
translations.idiomatic: At first the National Academy sacrifice was led by the director of education; later a Hanlin official was sent, though a newly appointed director still performed one sacrifice himself.

sentences.zh: 十七年，敕每月朔望，祭酒以下行釋菜禮，郡縣長以下詣學行香。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year an edict ordered that on the first and fifteenth of each month the director of education and those below should perform the vegetable libation rite, and prefectural and county chiefs and those below should proceed to the academy to offer incense.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year an edict required the director of education and his subordinates to perform the vegetable libation on the first and fifteenth of each month, and prefectural and county chiefs to visit the academy and offer incense.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，頒大成樂於天下。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Great Completion music was promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the Great Completion music was promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，以行人司副楊砥言，罷漢揚雄從祀，益以董仲舒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, on the statement of Yang Di, vice commissioner of the Foreign Envoys Office, Han Yang Xiong was removed from accompanying sacrifice and Dong Zhongshu was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, on the recommendation of Yang Di, vice commissioner of the Foreign Envoys Office, Han Yang Xiong was removed from accompanying sacrifice and Dong Zhongshu was added.

sentences.zh: 三十年，以國學孔子廟隘，命工部改作，其制皆帝所規畫。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, because the National Academy Temple of Confucius was cramped, the Ministry of Works was ordered to rebuild it; the layout was entirely planned by the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, because the National Academy temple was too cramped, the Ministry of Works was ordered to rebuild it according to the emperor's own design.

sentences.zh: 大成殿門各六楹，靈星門三，東西廡七十六楹，神廚庫皆八楹，宰牲所六楹。

translations.literal: The Great Completion Hall and gate each had six bays; the Spirit Star Gate had three; the eastern and western side halls had seventy-six bays; the spirit kitchen and storehouse each had eight bays; the slaughter pavilion had six bays.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Completion Hall and gate each had six bays, the Spirit Star Gate three, the eastern and western side halls seventy-six, the spirit kitchen and storehouse eight each, and the slaughter pavilion six.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，建廟於太學之東。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongle a temple was built east of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Yongle reign a temple was built east of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 宣德三年，以萬縣訓導李譯言，命禮部考正從祀先賢名位，頒示天下。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuande, on the statement of Li Yi, director of instruction in Wan County, the Ministry of Rites was ordered to examine and correct the names and ranks of sages in accompanying sacrifice and promulgate them throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuande, on the recommendation of Li Yi, director of instruction in Wan County, the Ministry of Rites was ordered to verify the names and ranks of sages in accompanying sacrifice and publish the list empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 十年，慈利教諭蔣明請祀元儒吳澄。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Jiang Ming, instructor of Cili, requested sacrifice to the Yuan Confucian Wu Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Jiang Ming, instructor of Cili, petitioned to add the Yuan scholar Wu Cheng to the sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 大學士楊士奇等言當從祀，從之。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Yang Shiqi and others said he should receive accompanying sacrifice; the request was followed.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Yang Shiqi and others argued that he should be included, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 正統二年，以宋儒胡安國、蔡沈、真德秀從祀。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengtong the Song Confucians Hu Anguo, Cai Shen, and Zhen Dexiu were added to accompanying sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhengtong the Song scholars Hu Anguo, Cai Shen, and Zhen Dexiu were added to accompanying sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 三年，禁天下祀孔子於釋、老宮。

translations.literal: In the third year sacrifice to Confucius in Buddhist and Daoist halls throughout the realm was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the court forbade sacrificing to Confucius in Buddhist and Daoist halls throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 孔、顏、孟三氏子孫教授裴侃言：「天下文廟惟論傳道，以列位次。

translations.literal: Pei Kan, instructor to the descendants of the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans, said: "Temples of culture throughout the realm consider only the transmission of the Way in arranging rank and order.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Kan, instructor to the descendants of the Kong, Yan, and Meng clans, said, "Temples throughout the realm rank figures only by their place in the transmission of the Way.

sentences.zh: 闕裡家廟，宜正父子，以敘彝倫。

translations.literal: In the family temple at Que Li, father and son should be set right in order to arrange the constant human relations."
translations.idiomatic: In the family temple at Que Li, father and son should be set in proper order to reflect the natural bonds of kinship."

sentences.zh: 顏子、曾子、子思，子也，配享殿廷。

translations.literal: Yanzi, Zengzi, and Zisi are sons and receive paired sacrifice in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzi, Zengzi, and Zisi are sons and receive paired sacrifice in the main hall.

sentences.zh: 無繇、子曨、伯魚，父也，從祀廊廡。

translations.literal: Wuyao, Zizhao, and Boyu are fathers and receive accompanying sacrifice in the corridor side halls.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyao, Zizhao, and Boyu are fathers and receive accompanying sacrifice in the corridor side halls.

sentences.zh: 非惟名分不正，抑恐神不自安。

translations.literal: Not only is the name and status incorrect; one also fears the spirits would not be at ease.
translations.idiomatic: This is not only improper in rank and title; the spirits themselves may not rest easy.

sentences.zh: 況叔樑紇元已追封啟聖王，創殿於大成殿西崇祀，而顏、孟之父俱封公，惟伯魚、子曨仍侯，乞追封公爵，偕顏、孟父俱配啟聖王殿。

translations.literal: Moreover, Shuliang He was already posthumously enfeoffed as King Who Initiates Sageliness in Yuan times, with a hall created west of the Great Completion Hall for lofty sacrifice, while the fathers of Yan and Meng were both enfeoffed as dukes—only Boyu and Zizhao remained marquises. I beg that they be posthumously enfeoffed as dukes and, together with the fathers of Yan and Meng, receive paired sacrifice in the Hall of the King Who Initiates Sageliness.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Shuliang He had already been posthumously enfeoffed as King Who Initiates Sageliness under the Yuan, with a hall west of the Great Completion Hall for his worship, while the fathers of Yan and Meng were both enfeoffed as dukes; only Boyu and Zizhao remained marquises. I ask that they be posthumously enfeoffed as dukes and, together with the fathers of Yan and Meng, receive paired sacrifice in the Hall of the King Who Initiates Sageliness.

sentences.zh: 」帝命禮部行之，仍議加伯魚、子曨封號。

translations.literal: " The emperor ordered the Ministry of Rites to carry it out and still deliberated on adding enfeoffed titles for Boyu and Zizhao.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Ministry of Rites to implement the change and also deliberated on elevating the titles of Boyu and Zizhao.

sentences.zh: 成化二年，追封董仲舒廣川伯，胡安國建甯伯，蔡沈崇安伯，真德秀浦城伯。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chenghua Dong Zhongshu was posthumously enfeoffed as Earl of Guangchuan, Hu Anguo as Earl of Jianning, Cai Shen as Earl of Chong'an, and Zhen Dexiu as Earl of Pucheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chenghua Dong Zhongshu was posthumously enfeoffed as Earl of Guangchuan, Hu Anguo as Earl of Jianning, Cai Shen as Earl of Chong'an, and Zhen Dexiu as Earl of Pucheng.

sentences.zh: 十二年，從祭酒周洪謨言，增樂舞為八佾，籩豆各十二。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, following the statement of Director of Education Zhou Hongmo, music and dance were increased to eight rows and platters and cups to twelve each.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, on the recommendation of Director of Education Zhou Hongmo, the music and dance were increased to eight rows and the platters and cups to twelve each.

sentences.zh: 弘治八年，追封楊時將樂伯。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Hongzhi Yang Shi was posthumously enfeoffed as Earl of Jiangle.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Hongzhi Yang Shi was posthumously enfeoffed as Earl of Jiangle.

sentences.zh: 從祀，位司馬光之次。

translations.literal: He received accompanying sacrifice, placed after Sima Guang.
translations.idiomatic: He was added to accompanying sacrifice, placed immediately after Sima Guang.

sentences.zh: 九年，增樂舞為七十二人，如天子之制。

translations.literal: In the ninth year music and dance were increased to seventy-two persons, following the Son of Heaven's regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the musicians and dancers were increased to seventy-two, matching the Son of Heaven's standard.

sentences.zh: 十二年，闕裡孔廟毀，敕有司重建。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the Kong temple at Que Li was destroyed; an edict ordered the local offices to rebuild it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the Confucius temple at Que Li was destroyed, and local officials were ordered to rebuild it.

sentences.zh: 十七年，廟成，遣大學士李東陽祭告，並立御製碑文。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, when the temple was completed, Grand Secretary Li Dongyang was dispatched to announce the sacrifice, and an imperially composed stele inscription was also erected.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, when the temple was finished, Grand Secretary Li Dongyang was sent to announce the completion, and an imperially composed stele inscription was erected.

sentences.zh: 正德十六年，詔有司改建孔氏家廟之在衢州者，官給錢，董其役。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Zhengde an edict ordered the local offices to rebuild the Kong clan family temple at Quzhou, with official funds supplied to oversee the work.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Zhengde local officials were ordered to rebuild the Kong clan family temple at Quzhou with state funds.

sentences.zh: 令博士孔承義奉祀。

translations.literal: Doctor Kong Chengyi was ordered to conduct the sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Doctor Kong Chengyi was appointed to maintain the sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖九年，大學士張璁言：「先師祀典，有當更正者。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Jiajing Grand Secretary Zhang Cong said: "In the sacrificial canon of the Former Teacher there are matters that should be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Jiajing Grand Secretary Zhang Cong said, "The sacrificial canon of the Former Teacher needs correction in several respects.

sentences.zh: 叔樑紇乃孔子之父，顏路、曾曨、孔鯉乃顏、曾、子思之父，三子配享廟庭，紇及諸父從祀兩廡，原聖賢之心豈安？

translations.literal: Shuliang He was Confucius's father; Yan Lu, Zeng Dian, and Kong Li were the fathers of Yan, Zeng, and Zisi. The three sons receive paired sacrifice in the temple court, while He and the various fathers receive accompanying sacrifice in the two side halls—would the hearts of the sages originally have been at ease with this?
translations.idiomatic: Shuliang He was Confucius's father; Yan Lu, Zeng Dian, and Kong Li were the fathers of Yan, Zeng, and Zisi. The three sons receive paired sacrifice in the main hall while He and the other fathers sit in the side halls—would the sages themselves have accepted this?

sentences.zh: 請於大成殿後，別立室祀叔樑紇，而以顏路、曾曨、孔鯉配之。

translations.literal: I request that behind the Great Completion Hall a separate chamber be established to sacrifice to Shuliang He, with Yan Lu, Zeng Dian, and Kong Li as his associates.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that a separate chamber be built behind the Great Completion Hall to honor Shuliang He, with Yan Lu, Zeng Dian, and Kong Li as his associates.

sentences.zh: 」帝以為然。

translations.literal: " The emperor held this correct.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 因言：「聖人尊天與尊親同。

translations.literal: He then said: "For the sage, honoring Heaven and honoring one's parents are the same.
translations.idiomatic: He added, "For the sage, honoring Heaven and honoring one's parents are one and the same.

sentences.zh: 今籩豆十二，牲用犢，全用祀天儀，亦非正禮。

translations.literal: Now with twelve platters and cups and a calf as victim, using entirely the rites of sacrificing to Heaven—this too is not correct ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Yet twelve platters and cups and a calf victim, using entirely the rites reserved for Heaven, are not proper ritual either.

sentences.zh: 其諡號、章服悉宜改正。

translations.literal: His posthumous title and ceremonial regalia should all be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: His posthumous titles and ceremonial regalia should all be revised.

sentences.zh: 」璁緣帝意，言：「孔子宜稱先聖先師，不稱王。

translations.literal: " Following the emperor's intent, Cong said: "Confucius should be called Former Sage and Former Teacher, not king.
translations.idiomatic: Following the emperor's intent, Cong proposed, "Confucius should be styled Former Sage and Former Teacher, not king.

sentences.zh: 祀宇宜稱廟，不稱殿。

translations.literal: The sacrificial structure should be called a temple, not a hall.
translations.idiomatic: The shrine should be called a temple, not a hall.

sentences.zh: 祀宜用木主，其塑像宜毀。

translations.literal: Sacrifice should use wooden spirit tablets; the sculpted images should be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice should use wooden spirit tablets, and the sculpted images should be removed.

sentences.zh: 籩豆用十，樂用六佾。

translations.literal: Platters and cups should number ten; music should use six rows.
translations.idiomatic: There should be ten platters and cups and six rows of dancers.

sentences.zh: 配位公侯伯之號宜削，止稱先賢先儒。

translations.literal: The titles of duke, marquis, and earl for associates should be cut away; they should be called only Former Worthies and Former Confucians.
translations.idiomatic: The ducal, marquis, and earl titles of associated figures should be dropped; they should be called only Former Worthies and Former Confucians.

sentences.zh: 其從祀申黨、公伯寮、秦冉等十二人宜罷，林放、蘧瑗等六人宜各祀於其鄉，後蒼、王通、歐陽修、胡瑗、蔡元定宜從祀。」

translations.literal: Among those in accompanying sacrifice, Shen Dang, Gongbo Liao, Qin Ran, and twelve others should be abolished; Lin Fang, Qu Yuan, and six others should each be sacrificed to in their native districts; Hou Cang, Wang Tong, Ouyang Xiu, Hu Yuan, and Cai Yuanding should receive accompanying sacrifice."
translations.idiomatic: Twelve accompanying figures including Shen Dang, Gongbo Liao, and Qin Ran should be removed; six others including Lin Fang and Qu Yuan should be honored only in their home districts; and Hou Cang, Wang Tong, Ouyang Xiu, Hu Yuan, and Cai Yuanding should be added to accompanying sacrifice."

sentences.zh: 帝命禮部會翰林諸臣議。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the Ministry of Rites to meet with the various Hanlin scholars to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Ministry of Rites to confer with the Hanlin scholars.

sentences.zh: 編修徐階疏陳易號毀像之不可。

translations.literal: Compiler Xu Jie memorialized in detail that changing the title and destroying the images were inadmissible.
translations.idiomatic: Compiler Xu Jie submitted a detailed memorial arguing that changing the title and destroying the images were unacceptable.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，謫階官，乃御製《正孔子祀典說》，大略謂孔子以魯僭王為非，寧肯自僭天子之禮？

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and demoted Jie's office. He then personally composed "An Explanation of Correcting Confucius's Sacrificial Canon," stating in general that Confucius regarded Lu's usurpation of the kingly title as wrong—how could he himself have usurped the Son of Heaven's rites?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was furious and demoted Xu Jie. He then personally composed An Explanation of Correcting Confucius's Sacrificial Canon, arguing in essence that Confucius had condemned Lu's assumption of royal titles and would never have accepted rites reserved for the Son of Heaven himself.

sentences.zh: 復為《正孔子祀典申記》，俱付史館。

translations.literal: He also composed "A Further Record on Correcting Confucius's Sacrificial Canon," and both were entrusted to the Historiography Office.
translations.idiomatic: He also wrote A Further Record on Correcting Confucius's Sacrificial Canon, and both texts were sent to the Historiography Office.

sentences.zh: 璁因作《正孔子廟祀典或問》奏之。

translations.literal: Cong thereupon composed "Questions and Answers on Correcting the Sacrificial Canon of the Confucius Temple" and submitted it.
translations.idiomatic: Cong then composed Questions and Answers on Correcting the Sacrificial Canon of the Confucius Temple and submitted it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝以為議論詳正，並令禮部集議。

translations.literal: The emperor held the discussion detailed and correct, and also ordered the Ministry of Rites to gather for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor found the argument thorough and sound and ordered the Ministry of Rites to convene a full deliberation.

sentences.zh: 於是御史黎貫等言：「聖祖初正祀典，天下嶽瀆諸神皆去其號，惟先師孔子如故，良有深意。

translations.literal: Thereupon Censor Li Guan and others said: "When the Sagely Ancestor first corrected the sacrificial canon, the spirits of mountains, rivers, and mounds throughout the realm all had their titles removed—only the Former Teacher Confucius remained as before; this surely had deep meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Li Guan and others then said, "When the Sagely Ancestor first reformed the sacrificial canon, he stripped the titles from spirits of mountains and rivers throughout the realm but left the Former Teacher Confucius unchanged—surely with deep purpose.

sentences.zh: 陛下疑孔子之祀上擬祀天之禮。

translations.literal: Your Majesty suspects that sacrifice to Confucius ranks above and approximates sacrifice to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty suspects that sacrifice to Confucius ranks too close to sacrifice to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 夫子以不可及也，猶天之不可階而升，雖擬諸天，亦不為過。

translations.literal: The Master is said to be unreachable, like Heaven that cannot be climbed by steps—even if compared to Heaven, it would not be excessive.
translations.idiomatic: The Master is beyond reach, like Heaven that cannot be climbed by steps; even a comparison with Heaven would not be excessive.

sentences.zh: 自唐尊孔子為文宣王，已用天子禮樂。

translations.literal: Since Tang honored Confucius as King of Literary Propagation, the Son of Heaven's ritual music has already been used.
translations.idiomatic: Since Tang honored Confucius as King of Literary Propagation, the rites and music of the Son of Heaven have already been used for him.

sentences.zh: 宋真宗嘗欲封孔子為帝，或謂周止稱王，不當加帝號。

translations.literal: Song Zhenzong once wished to enfeoff Confucius as emperor; some said Zhou stopped at calling him king and one should not add the title of emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Song Zhenzong once wished to enfeoff Confucius as emperor, but some argued that Zhou had stopped at king and the title of emperor should not be added.

sentences.zh: 而羅從彥之論，則謂加帝號亦可。

translations.literal: Yet Luo Congyan's discussion held that adding the title of emperor was also acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Luo Congyan argued that adding the title of emperor was also acceptable.

sentences.zh: 至周敦頤則以為萬世無窮王祀孔子，邵雍則以為仲尼以萬世為王。

translations.literal: Zhou Dunyi held that for ten thousand generations without end kings sacrifice to Confucius; Shao Yong held that Zhong Ni takes ten thousand generations as his kingship.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Dunyi held that kings would sacrifice to Confucius for endless generations; Shao Yong held that Zhong Ni was king for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 其辨孔子不當稱王者，止吳澄一人而已。

translations.literal: Of those who argued that Confucius should not be called king, there was only Wu Cheng alone.
translations.idiomatic: Of those who argued that Confucius should not be called king, only Wu Cheng stood alone.

sentences.zh: 伏望博考羣言，務求至當。

translations.literal: I humbly hope Your Majesty will broadly examine the various opinions and strive for what is most fitting.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly beg Your Majesty to examine the full range of opinion and arrive at what is most fitting.

sentences.zh: 」時貫疏中言：「莫尊於天地，亦莫尊於父師。

translations.literal: " At that time Guan's memorial also said: "Nothing is more honored than Heaven and Earth; nothing is more honored than father and teacher.
translations.idiomatic: Guan's memorial also said, "Nothing stands higher than Heaven and Earth, and nothing stands higher than father and teacher.

sentences.zh: 陛下敬天尊親，不應獨疑孔子王號為僭。

translations.literal: Your Majesty reveres Heaven and honors kin—you should not alone suspect Confucius's kingly title of being usurpation.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty reveres Heaven and honors kin; you should not single out Confucius's royal title as usurpation.

sentences.zh: 」帝因大怒，疑貫藉此以斥其追尊皇考之非，詆為奸惡，下法司會訊，褫其職。

translations.literal: " The emperor thereupon was greatly enraged, suspecting that Guan used this to condemn his error in posthumously honoring his imperial father, denouncing him as treacherous and wicked, and sent him down to the judicial offices for joint interrogation, stripping his office.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor flew into a rage, suspecting that Guan was using this argument to attack his posthumous elevation of his father. He denounced Guan as treacherous, handed him to the judicial offices for interrogation, and stripped him of office.

sentences.zh: 給事中王汝梅等亦極言不宜去王號，帝皆斥為謬論。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Wang Rumei and others also spoke forcefully that the kingly title should not be removed; the emperor rejected all as fallacious discourse.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Wang Rumei and others also argued forcefully against removing the royal title, but the emperor dismissed them all as mistaken.

sentences.zh: 於是禮部會諸臣議：「人以聖人為至，聖人以孔子為至。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Ministry of Rites met with the various officials to deliberate: "People take the sage as ultimate; sages take Confucius as ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites then convened the officials, who argued, "People regard the sage as supreme, and sages regard Confucius as supreme.

sentences.zh: 宋真宗稱孔子為至，宋真宗稱孔子為至聖，其意已備。

translations.literal: Song Zhenzong called Confucius ultimate; Song Zhenzong called Confucius Most Sage—the meaning was already complete.
translations.idiomatic: Song Zhenzong called Confucius ultimate and Most Sage; the meaning was already complete.

sentences.zh: 今宜於孔子神位題至聖先師孔子，去其王號及大成、文宣之稱。

translations.literal: Now on Confucius's spirit tablet one should inscribe Most Sage and Former Teacher Confucius, removing his kingly title and the designations Great Completion and Literary Propagation.
translations.idiomatic: Confucius's spirit tablet should now read Most Sage and Former Teacher Confucius, and his royal title together with the designations Great Completion and Literary Propagation should be removed.

sentences.zh: 改大成殿為先師廟，大成門為廟門。

translations.literal: Change the Great Completion Hall to the Former Teacher Temple and the Great Completion Gate to the temple gate.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Completion Hall was to become the Former Teacher Temple and the Great Completion Gate the temple gate.

sentences.zh: 其四配稱復聖顏子、宗聖曾子、述聖子思子、亞聖孟子。

translations.literal: His four associates should be called Returning Sage Yanzi, Ancestral Sage Zengzi, Transmitting Sage Zisi, and Second Sage Mencius.
translations.idiomatic: His four associates were to be styled Returning Sage Yanzi, Ancestral Sage Zengzi, Transmitting Sage Zisi, and Second Sage Mencius.

sentences.zh: 十哲以下凡及門弟子，皆稱先賢某子。

translations.literal: Below the Ten Wise Ones, all disciples who entered his gate should be called Former Worthy Master So-and-so.
translations.idiomatic: All disciples below the Ten Wise Ones were to be called Former Worthy Master So-and-so.

sentences.zh: 左丘明以下，皆稱先儒某子，不復稱公侯伯。

translations.literal: From Zuo Qiuming downward, all should be called Former Confucian Master So-and-so, no longer called duke, marquis, or earl.
translations.idiomatic: From Zuo Qiuming downward all were to be called Former Confucian Master So-and-so, with ducal, marquis, and earl titles dropped.

sentences.zh: 遵聖祖首定南京國子監規制，制木為神主。

translations.literal: Following the Sagely Ancestor's first fixing of the Nanjing Directorate of Education regulations, wooden spirit tablets should be made.
translations.idiomatic: Following the Sagely Ancestor's original Nanjing Directorate regulations, wooden spirit tablets were to be made.

sentences.zh: 仍擬大小尺寸，著為定式。

translations.literal: Sizes large and small should still be drafted and fixed as standard forms.
translations.idiomatic: Standard dimensions were to be drafted and fixed as permanent forms.

sentences.zh: 其塑像即令屏撤。

translations.literal: The sculpted images should immediately be ordered removed and set aside.
translations.idiomatic: Sculpted images were to be removed at once.

sentences.zh: 春秋祭祀，遵國初舊制，十籩十豆。

translations.literal: For spring and autumn sacrifices, follow the founding regulation: ten platters and ten cups.
translations.idiomatic: Spring and autumn sacrifices were to follow the founding standard of ten platters and ten cups.

sentences.zh: 天下各學，八籩八豆。

translations.literal: At every academy throughout the realm, eight platters and eight cups.
translations.idiomatic: At every academy throughout the realm there were to be eight platters and eight cups.

sentences.zh: 樂舞止六佾。

translations.literal: Music and dance should stop at six rows.
translations.idiomatic: Music and dance were limited to six rows.

sentences.zh: 凡學別立一祠，中叔樑紇，題啟聖化孔氏神位，以顏無繇、曾點、孔鯉、孟孫氏配，俱稱先賢某氏，至從祀之賢，不可不考其得失。

translations.literal: At every academy a separate shrine should be established, with Shuliang He in the center, inscribed as the spirit seat of the Kong clan who initiated sageliness; Yan Wuyao, Zeng Dian, Kong Li, and the Meng clan as associates—all called Former Worthy Master Such-and-such Clan. As for worthies in accompanying sacrifice, one cannot fail to examine their merits and faults.
translations.idiomatic: Each academy was to have a separate shrine with Shuliang He at the center, titled spirit seat of the Kong clan who initiated sageliness, and Yan Wuyao, Zeng Dian, Kong Li, and the Meng clan as associates, all styled Former Worthy Master of their clan. Figures in accompanying sacrifice had to be weighed on their merits and faults.

sentences.zh: 申黨即申棖，釐去其一。

translations.literal: Shen Dang is Shen Cheng; one of the two should be removed.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Dang and Shen Cheng were the same person; one entry should be removed.

sentences.zh: 公伯寮、秦冉、顏何、荀況、戴聖、劉向、賈逵、馬融、何休、王肅、王弼、杜預、吳澄罷祀。

translations.literal: Gongbo Liao, Qin Ran, Yan He, Xun Kuang, Dai Sheng, Liu Xiang, Jia Kui, Ma Rong, He Xiu, Wang Su, Wang Bi, Du Yu, and Wu Cheng should have sacrifice abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Gongbo Liao, Qin Ran, Yan He, Xun Kuang, Dai Sheng, Liu Xiang, Jia Kui, Ma Rong, He Xiu, Wang Su, Wang Bi, Du Yu, and Wu Cheng were removed from sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 林放、蘧瑗、盧植、鄭眾、鄭玄、服虔、範甯各祀於其鄉。

translations.literal: Lin Fang, Qu Yuan, Lu Zhi, Zheng Zhong, Zheng Xuan, Fu Qian, and Fan Ning should each be sacrificed to in their native districts.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Fang, Qu Yuan, Lu Zhi, Zheng Zhong, Zheng Xuan, Fu Qian, and Fan Ning were to be honored only in their home districts.

sentences.zh: 後蒼、王通、歐陽修、胡瑗宜增入。

translations.literal: Hou Cang, Wang Tong, Ouyang Xiu, and Hu Yuan should be added.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Cang, Wang Tong, Ouyang Xiu, and Hu Yuan were to be added.

sentences.zh: 」命悉如議行。

translations.literal: " An order followed that everything should be carried out as deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that everything be implemented as proposed.

sentences.zh: 又以行人薛侃議，進陸九淵從祀。

translations.literal: Also on the proposal of Envoy Xue Kan, Lu Jiuyuan was advanced to accompanying sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the proposal of Envoy Xue Kan, Lu Jiuyuan was also added to accompanying sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 初，洪武時，司業宋濂請去像設主，禮儀樂章多所更定，太祖不允。

translations.literal: At first, in Hongwu times, Vice Director Song Lian requested removing images and setting up tablets, with many changes to ritual and music—Taizu did not approve.
translations.idiomatic: Under Hongwu, Vice Director Song Lian had asked to remove images in favor of tablets and revise much of the ritual music, but Taizu refused.

sentences.zh: 成、弘間，少詹程敏政嘗謂馬融等八人當斥。

translations.literal: Between Chenghua and Hongzhi, Junior Mentor Cheng Minzheng once said that Ma Rong and eight others should be expelled.
translations.idiomatic: Between Chenghua and Hongzhi, Junior Mentor Cheng Minzheng had argued that Ma Rong and seven others should be expelled.

sentences.zh: 給事中張九功推言之，並請罷荀況、公伯寮、蘧瑗等，而進後蒼、王通、胡瑗。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Zhang Jiugong extended the argument, also requesting abolition of Xun Kuang, Gongbo Liao, Qu Yuan, and others, while advancing Hou Cang, Wang Tong, and Hu Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Zhang Jiugong elaborated the argument, asking to remove Xun Kuang, Gongbo Liao, Qu Yuan, and others while adding Hou Cang, Wang Tong, and Hu Yuan.

sentences.zh: 為禮官周洪謨所卻而止。

translations.literal: It was rejected by the ritual official Zhou Hongmo and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual official Zhou Hongmo blocked the proposal and nothing came of it.

sentences.zh: 至是以璁力主，眾不敢違。

translations.literal: At this point Cong forcefully championed it, and none dared disobey.
translations.idiomatic: Now Cong pressed the matter forcefully, and no one dared object.

sentences.zh: 毀像蓋用濂說，先賢去留，略如九功言。

translations.literal: Destroying the images broadly followed Lian's proposal; which former worthies were removed or kept largely followed Jiugong's words.
