translations.idiomatic: Destroying the images followed Song Lian's proposal in essence, and the roster of former worthies largely followed Zhang Jiugong's recommendations.

sentences.zh: 其進歐陽修，則以濮議故也。

translations.literal: The advancement of Ouyang Xiu was because of the affair of the Pu succession.
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Xiu was included because of the Pu succession controversy.

sentences.zh: 明年，國子監建啟聖公祠成。

translations.literal: The next year the Directorate of Education's construction of the Shrine of the Duke Who Initiates Sageliness was completed.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Directorate of Education finished the Shrine of the Duke Who Initiates Sageliness.

sentences.zh: 從尚書李時言，春秋祭祀，與文廟同日。

translations.literal: Following Minister Li Shi's statement, spring and autumn sacrifices were held on the same day as the Temple of Culture.
translations.idiomatic: Following Minister Li Shi's recommendation, spring and autumn sacrifices were held on the same day as at the Temple of Culture.

sentences.zh: 籩豆牲帛視四配，東西配位視十哲，從祀先儒程晌、硃鬆、蔡元定視兩廡。

translations.literal: Platters, cups, victims, and silks followed the four associates; eastern and western associate positions followed the Ten Wise Ones; accompanying Former Confucians Cheng Xiang, Zhu Song, and Cai Yuanding followed the two side halls.
translations.idiomatic: Platters, cups, victims, and silk matched the four associates; eastern and western associate positions matched the Ten Wise Ones; and accompanying Former Confucians Cheng Xiang, Zhu Song, and Cai Yuanding matched the side halls.

sentences.zh: 輔臣代祭文廟，則祭酒祭啟聖祠。

translations.literal: When supporting ministers sacrificed in place at the Temple of Culture, the director of education sacrificed at the Shrine of the Duke Who Initiates Sageliness.
translations.idiomatic: When supporting ministers performed the substitute sacrifice at the Temple of Culture, the director of education sacrificed at the Shrine of the Duke Who Initiates Sageliness.

sentences.zh: 南京祭酒於文廟，司業於啟聖祠。

translations.literal: At Nanjing the director of education sacrificed at the Temple of Culture and the vice director at the Shrine of the Duke Who Initiates Sageliness.
translations.idiomatic: At Nanjing the director of education sacrificed at the Temple of Culture and the vice director at the Shrine of the Duke Who Initiates Sageliness.

sentences.zh: 遂定制，殿中先師南向，四配東西向。

translations.literal: Regulations were then fixed: in the hall the Former Teacher faced south and the four associates faced east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations were then fixed: in the main hall the Former Teacher faced south and the four associates faced east and west.

sentences.zh: 稍後十哲：閔子損、冉子雍、端木子賜、仲子由、卜子商、冉子耕、宰子予、冉子求、言子偃、顓孫子師皆東西向。

translations.literal: Slightly behind, the Ten Wise Ones—Master Min, Master Ran Yong, Master Duanmu Ci, Master Zhong You, Master Bu Shang, Master Ran Geng, Master Zai Yu, Master Ran Qiu, Master Yan Yan, and Master Zhuansun Shi—all faced east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Behind them stood the Ten Wise Ones—Minzi, Ran Yong, Duanmu Ci, Zhong You, Bu Shang, Ran Geng, Zai Yu, Ran Qiu, Yan Yan, and Zhuansun Shi—all facing east and west.

sentences.zh: 兩廡從祀：先賢澹臺滅明、宓不齊、原憲、公冶長、南宮適、高柴、漆雕開、樊須、司馬耕、公西赤、有若、琴張、申棖、陳亢、巫馬施、樑鱣、公曨哀、商瞿、冉孺、顏辛、伯虔、曹恤、冉季、公孫龍、漆雕哆、秦商、漆雕徒父、顏高、商澤、壤駟赤、任不齊、石作蜀、公良孺、公夏首、公肩定、後處、鄡單、奚容ＡＭ、罕父黑、顏祖、榮旂、秦祖、左人郢、句井疆、鄭國、公祖句茲、原亢、縣成、廉潔、燕伋、叔仲會、顏之僕、邽巽、樂欬、公西輿如、狄黑、孔忠、公西ＡＭ、步叔乘、施之常、秦非、顏噲，先儒左丘明、公羊高、穀梁赤、伏勝、高堂生、孔安國、毛萇、董仲舒、後蒼、杜子春、王通、韓愈、胡瑗、周敦頤、程顥、歐陽修、邵雍、張載、司馬光、程頤、楊時、胡安國、硃熹、張栻、陸九淵、呂祖謙、蔡沈、真德秀、許衡凡九十一人。

translations.literal: In the two side halls for accompanying sacrifice: Former Worthies Dantai Mieming, Mi Buqi, Yuan Xian, Gongye Chang, Nangong Kuo, Gao Chai, Qidiao Kai, Fan Xu, Sima Geng, Gongxi Chi, You Ruo, Qin Zhang, Shen Cheng, Chen Kang, Wuma Shi, Liang Yu, Gongxi Ai, Shang Qu, Ran Ru, Yan Xin, Bo Qian, Cao Xu, Ran Ji, Gongsun Long, Qidiao Duo, Qin Shang, Qidiao Tufu, Yan Gao, Shang Ze, Rangsi Chi, Ren Buqi, Shizuo Shu, Gongliang Ru, Gongxia Shou, Gongjian Ding, Hou Chu, Zou Dan, Xi Rongdian, Hanfu Hei, Yanzu, Rong Qi, Qin Zu, Zuoren Ying, Goujing Jiang, Zheng Guo, Gongzu Gouzi, Yuan Kang, Xian Cheng, Lian Jie, Yan Ji, Shuzhong Hui, Yan Zhipu, Gui Sun, Yue Kuo, Gongxi Yuru, Di Hei, Kong Zhong, Gongxi Dian, Bushu Cheng, Shi Zhichang, Qin Fei, and Yan Kuai; Former Confucians Zuo Qiuming, Gongsun Gao, Guliang Chi, Fu Sheng, Gaotang Sheng, Kong Anguo, Mao Chang, Dong Zhongshu, Hou Cang, Du Zichun, Wang Tong, Han Yu, Hu Yuan, Zhou Dunyi, Cheng Hao, Ouyang Xiu, Shao Yong, Zhang Zai, Sima Guang, Cheng Yi, Yang Shi, Hu Anguo, Zhu Xi, Zhang Shi, Lu Jiuyuan, Lu Zuqian, Cai Shen, Zhen Dexiu, and Xu Heng—in all ninety-one persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the two side halls ninety-one figures received accompanying sacrifice: the Former Worthies Dantai Mieming, Mi Buqi, Yuan Xian, Gongye Chang, Nangong Kuo, Gao Chai, Qidiao Kai, Fan Xu, Sima Geng, Gongxi Chi, You Ruo, Qin Zhang, Shen Cheng, Chen Kang, Wuma Shi, Liang Yu, Gongxi Ai, Shang Qu, Ran Ru, Yan Xin, Bo Qian, Cao Xu, Ran Ji, Gongsun Long, Qidiao Duo, Qin Shang, Qidiao Tufu, Yan Gao, Shang Ze, Rangsi Chi, Ren Buqi, Shizuo Shu, Gongliang Ru, Gongxia Shou, Gongjian Ding, Hou Chu, Zou Dan, Xi Rongdian, Hanfu Hei, Yanzu, Rong Qi, Qin Zu, Zuoren Ying, Goujing Jiang, Zheng Guo, Gongzu Gouzi, Yuan Kang, Xian Cheng, Lian Jie, Yan Ji, Shuzhong Hui, Yan Zhipu, Gui Sun, Yue Kuo, Gongxi Yuru, Di Hei, Kong Zhong, Gongxi Dian, Bushu Cheng, Shi Zhichang, Qin Fei, and Yan Kuai, together with the Former Confucians Zuo Qiuming, Gongsun Gao, Guliang Chi, Fu Sheng, Gaotang Sheng, Kong Anguo, Mao Chang, Dong Zhongshu, Hou Cang, Du Zichun, Wang Tong, Han Yu, Hu Yuan, Zhou Dunyi, Cheng Hao, Ouyang Xiu, Shao Yong, Zhang Zai, Sima Guang, Cheng Yi, Yang Shi, Hu Anguo, Zhu Xi, Zhang Shi, Lu Jiuyuan, Lu Zuqian, Cai Shen, Zhen Dexiu, and Xu Heng.

sentences.zh: 隆慶五年，以薛瑄從祀。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Longqing Xue Xuan was added to accompanying sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Longqing Xue Xuan was added to accompanying sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 萬曆中，以羅從彥、李侗從祀。

translations.literal: During Wanli, Luo Congyan and Li Tong were added to accompanying sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: During Wanli, Luo Congyan and Li Tong were added to accompanying sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 十二年，又以陳獻章、胡居仁、王守仁從祀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Chen Xianzhang, Hu Juren, and Wang Shouren were also added to accompanying sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Chen Xianzhang, Hu Juren, and Wang Shouren were also added.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，以宋周敦頤父輔成從祀啟聖祠。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the Song Confucian Zhou Dunyi's father Fucheng was added to accompanying sacrifice in the Shrine of the Duke Who Initiates Sageliness.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Zhou Dunyi's father Fucheng was added to the Shrine of the Duke Who Initiates Sageliness.

sentences.zh: 又定每歲仲春、秋上丁日禦殿傳制，遣大臣祭先師及配位。

translations.literal: It was also fixed that each year on the first ding day of the second month of spring and autumn, an edict would be promulgated from the imperial hall and great ministers dispatched to sacrifice to the Former Teacher and his associates.
translations.idiomatic: It was also ruled that on the first ding day of the second month of spring and of autumn each year, an edict would be issued from the imperial hall and senior ministers sent to sacrifice to the Former Teacher and his associates.

sentences.zh: 其十哲以翰林官、兩廡以國子監官各二員分獻。

translations.literal: For the Ten Wise Ones two Hanlin officials made divided offerings; for the two side halls two Directorate of Education officials each did so.
translations.idiomatic: Two Hanlin officials made the divided offerings to the Ten Wise Ones, and two Directorate officials to each side hall.

sentences.zh: 每月朔，及每科進士行釋菜禮。

translations.literal: On the first of each month, and whenever a cohort of jinshi was produced, the vegetable libation rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of each month, and whenever a new cohort of jinshi graduated, the vegetable libation rite was performed.

sentences.zh: 司府州縣衛學各提調官行禮。

translations.literal: At prefectural, subprefectural, county, and guard academies, each supervising official performed the rite.
translations.idiomatic: At prefectural, county, and guard academies the supervising official performed the rite.

sentences.zh: 牲用少牢，樂如太學。

translations.literal: Victims used the lesser offering; music followed the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: The lesser offering was used and the music followed the Imperial Academy standard.

sentences.zh: 京府及附府縣學，止行釋菜禮。

translations.literal: At capital prefectures and attached prefectural and county academies, only the vegetable libation rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: Capital prefectures and their attached county academies performed only the vegetable libation.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十五年，以左丘明親授經於聖人，改稱先賢。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Chongzhen, because Zuo Qiuming had personally received the classics from the Sage, he was changed to be called Former Worthy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Chongzhen, because Zuo Qiuming had received the classics directly from the Sage, he was restyled Former Worthy.

sentences.zh: 並改宋儒周、二程、張、硃、邵六子亦稱先賢，位七十子下，漢唐諸儒之上。

translations.literal: The six Song Confucians Zhou, the two Chengs, Zhang, Zhu, and Shao were also changed to be called Former Worthies, placed below the seventy disciples and above the various Confucians of Han and Tang.
translations.idiomatic: The six Song masters Zhou Dunyi, the two Chengs, Zhang Zai, Zhu Xi, and Shao Yong were also restyled Former Worthies, ranked below the seventy disciples and above the Han and Tang scholars.

sentences.zh: 然僅國學更置之，闕裡廟廷及天下學宮未遑頒行也。

translations.literal: Yet only the National Academy rearranged them; the temple court at Que Li and academies throughout the realm had not yet had time to promulgate and implement it.
translations.idiomatic: Only the National Academy had rearranged the tablets; the temple at Que Li and academies throughout the realm had not yet implemented the change.

sentences.zh: ○旗纛

translations.literal: ○ Banners and Pennants
translations.idiomatic: Banners and Pennants

sentences.zh: 旗纛之祭有四。

translations.literal: Sacrifice to banners and pennants has four forms.
translations.idiomatic: There were four forms of sacrifice to banners and pennants.

sentences.zh: 其一，洪武元年，禮官奏：「軍行旗纛所當祭者，旗謂牙旗。

translations.literal: The first: in the first year of Hongwu the ritual officials memorialized: "In military campaigns what should be sacrificed to for banners and pennants—the banner means the tusk-flag.
translations.idiomatic: First: in the first year of Hongwu the ritual officials reported, "On campaign the banners and pennants to be honored include the tusk-flag.

sentences.zh: 黃帝出軍訣曰：『牙旗者，將軍之精，一軍之形侯。

translations.literal: The Yellow Emperor's Military Deployment Formula says: 'The tusk-flag is the essence of the general, the form and omen of an entire army.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow Emperor's Military Deployment Formula says, "The tusk-flag is the general's essence and the army's visible sign.

sentences.zh: 凡始豎牙，必祭以剛日。

translations.literal: Whenever tusks are first raised, sacrifice must be on a gang day.'"
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the tusks are first raised, sacrifice must be performed on a gang day."

sentences.zh: 』纛，謂旗頭也。

translations.literal: ' The pennant means the banner head.
translations.idiomatic: The pennant is the banner head.

sentences.zh: 《太白陰經》曰：『大將中營建纛。

translations.literal: The Classic of the Great White Yin says: 'The great general erects the pennant in the central camp.
translations.idiomatic: The Classic of the Great White Yin says, "The great general erects the pennant in the central camp.

sentences.zh: 天子六軍，故用六纛。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven has six armies, hence six pennants are used.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven has six armies, so six pennants are used.

sentences.zh: 犛牛尾為之，在左騑馬首。

translations.literal: They are made of yak tails and placed at the head of the left outrider horse.'"
translations.idiomatic: They are made of yak tails and placed at the head of the left outrider horse."

sentences.zh: 』 唐、宋及元皆有旗纛之祭。

translations.literal: ' Tang, Song, and Yuan all had sacrifice to banners and pennants.
translations.idiomatic: Tang, Song, and Yuan all maintained sacrifice to banners and pennants.

sentences.zh: 今宜立廟京師，春用驚蟄，秋用霜降日，遣官致祭。

translations.literal: Now a temple should be established in the capital; in spring use the Awakening of Insects, in autumn the Frost Descent day, and dispatch officials to perform sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: A temple should now be built in the capital, with sacrifice in spring on the Awakening of Insects and in autumn on Frost Descent, performed by dispatched officials.

sentences.zh: 」乃命建廟於都督府治之後，以都督為獻官，題主曰軍牙之神、六纛之神。

translations.literal: " An order followed to build a temple behind the regional military commissioner's administration, with the commissioner as offering official; the tablets were inscribed Spirit of the Army Tusk and Spirit of the Six Pennants.
translations.idiomatic: A temple was ordered behind the regional military commissioner's headquarters, with the commissioner as offering official and tablets inscribed Spirit of the Army Tusk and Spirit of the Six Pennants.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，詔皇太子率諸王詣閱武場祭旗纛，為壇七，行三獻禮。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year an edict ordered the crown prince to lead the princes to the review ground to sacrifice to banners and pennants, with seven altars and the three-offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year the crown prince was ordered to lead the princes to the review ground to sacrifice to banners and pennants on seven altars with the threefold offering.

sentences.zh: 後停春祭，止霜降日祭於教場。

translations.literal: Later the spring sacrifice was stopped; only on Frost Descent day was sacrifice performed at the drill ground.
translations.idiomatic: Later the spring sacrifice was discontinued, leaving only the Frost Descent rite at the drill ground.

sentences.zh: 其二，歲暮享太廟日，祭旗纛於承天門外。

translations.literal: The second: on the day of the year-end offering at the Grand Temple, banners and pennants were sacrificed to outside the Gate of Accepting Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Second: on the day of the year-end offering at the Grand Temple, banners and pennants were sacrificed to outside the Gate of Accepting Heaven.

sentences.zh: 其三，旗纛廟在山川壇左。

translations.literal: The third: the Temple of Banners and Pennants stood to the left of the Altars of Mountains and Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Third: the Temple of Banners and Pennants stood to the left of the Altars of Mountains and Rivers.

sentences.zh: 初，旗纛與太歲諸神合祭於城南。

translations.literal: At first banners and pennants were jointly sacrificed with the Year Star and other spirits south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: At first banners and pennants were sacrificed together with the Year Star and other spirits south of the city.

sentences.zh: 九年，別建廟。

translations.literal: In the ninth year a separate temple was built.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year a separate temple was built.

sentences.zh: 每歲仲秋，天子躬祀山川之日，遣旗手衛官行禮。

translations.literal: Each year in the second month of autumn, on the day when the Son of Heaven personally sacrificed to mountains and rivers, officials of the Banner Bearer Guard performed the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Each year in the second month of autumn, on the day the emperor sacrificed in person to mountains and rivers, officials of the Banner Bearer Guard performed the rite.

sentences.zh: 其正祭，旗頭大將、六纛大將、五方旗神、主宰戰船正神、金鼓角銃砲之神、弓弩飛槍飛石之神、陣前陣後神祇五昌等眾，凡七位，共一壇，南向。

translations.literal: For the main sacrifice: the great general of the banner head, the great general of the six pennants, the spirit of the five-direction banners, the chief spirit presiding over war vessels, the spirits of bells, drums, horns, guns, and cannon, the spirits of bows, crossbows, flying spears, and flying stones, and the host of spirits before and behind the battle array including Wuchang—in all seven positions on one altar facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The main sacrifice honored seven spirits on one south-facing altar: the generals of the banner head and six pennants, the five-direction banner spirit, the spirit presiding over war vessels, the spirits of bells, drums, horns, guns, and cannon, the spirits of bows, crossbows, flying spears, and stones, and the spirits before and behind the battle line including Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 皇帝服皮弁，禦奉天殿降香。

translations.literal: The emperor wore the deerskin cap, proceeded to the Hall of Supreme Harmony, and sent down incense.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore the deerskin cap and proceeded to the Hall of Supreme Harmony to send down incense.

sentences.zh: 獻官奉以從事。

translations.literal: The offering official received it and carried out the affair.
translations.idiomatic: The offering official received the incense and conducted the rite.

sentences.zh: 祭物視先農，帛七，黑二白五。

translations.literal: Sacrificial goods followed those for the Former Farmer: seven silks, two black and five white.
translations.idiomatic: Offerings followed the Former Farmer standard: seven bolts of silk, two black and five white.

sentences.zh: 瘞毛血、望燎，與風雲雷雨諸神同。

translations.literal: Burying fur and blood and gazing at the burning offering were the same as for the spirits of wind, cloud, thunder, and rain.
translations.idiomatic: Burying fur and blood and watching the flame offering followed the same procedure as for the spirits of wind, cloud, thunder, and rain.

sentences.zh: 祭畢，設酒器六於地。

translations.literal: When sacrifice was finished, six wine vessels were set on the ground.
translations.idiomatic: After the sacrifice six wine vessels were set on the ground.

sentences.zh: 刺雄雞六，瀝血以釁之。

translations.literal: Six roosters were stabbed and blood drained to smear them as libation.
translations.idiomatic: Six roosters were killed and their blood drained to smear the vessels as libation.

sentences.zh: 其四，永樂後，有神旗之祭，專祭火雷之神。

translations.literal: The fourth: after Yongle there was sacrifice to the spirit banner, devoted to the spirits of fire and thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: after Yongle there was sacrifice to the spirit banner, devoted solely to the spirits of fire and thunder.

sentences.zh: 每月朔望，神機營提督官祭於教場。

translations.literal: On the first and fifteenth of each month the supervising officer of the Divine Engine Camp sacrificed at the drill ground.
translations.idiomatic: On the first and fifteenth of each month the supervising officer of the Divine Engine Camp sacrificed at the drill ground.

sentences.zh: 牲用少牢。

translations.literal: Victims used the lesser offering.
translations.idiomatic: The lesser offering was used.

sentences.zh: 凡旗纛皆藏內府，祭則設之。

translations.literal: All banners and pennants were stored in the inner palace storehouse and set out when sacrifice was performed.
translations.idiomatic: All banners and pennants were kept in the inner palace storehouse and brought out for sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 王國祭旗纛，則遣武官戎服行禮。

translations.literal: When princely domains sacrificed to banners and pennants, military officials in battle dress were dispatched to perform the rite.
translations.idiomatic: In princely domains military officials in battle dress performed the banner and pennant sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 天下衛所於公署後立廟，以指揮使為初獻官。

translations.literal: Guard posts throughout the realm built temples behind their public offices, with the commander as primary offering official.
translations.idiomatic: Guard posts throughout the realm built temples behind their offices, with the commander making the primary offering.

sentences.zh: 僚屬為亞獻、終獻。

translations.literal: Subordinates served as secondary and final offering officials.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates made the secondary and final offerings.

sentences.zh: 儀物殺京都。

translations.literal: Ritual goods were reduced from those of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual goods were scaled down from the capital standard.

sentences.zh: ○五祀

translations.literal: ○ The Five Sacrifices
translations.idiomatic: The Five Sacrifices

sentences.zh: 洪武二年定制，歲終臘享，通祭於廟門外。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongwu regulations were fixed: at year-end the la offering was enjoyed, with universal sacrifice outside the temple gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Hongwu regulations fixed a year-end la offering with universal sacrifice outside the temple gate.

sentences.zh: 八年，禮部奏：「五祀之禮，周、漢、唐、宋不一。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Ministry of Rites memorialized: "The rites of the Five Sacrifices differ among Zhou, Han, Tang, and Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Ministry of Rites reported, "The rites of the Five Sacrifices differed among Zhou, Han, Tang, and Song.

sentences.zh: 今擬孟春祀戶，設壇皇宮門左，司門主之。

translations.literal: Now it is proposed that in the first month of spring the Door be sacrificed to, with an altar set to the left of the imperial palace gate, presided over by the gate office.
translations.idiomatic: It was proposed to sacrifice to the Door in the first month of spring at an altar left of the imperial palace gate, presided over by the gate office.

sentences.zh: 孟夏祀竈，設壇禦廚，光祿寺官主之。

translations.literal: In the first month of summer sacrifice to the Stove, with an altar in the imperial kitchen, presided over by an official of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of summer sacrifice to the Stove at an altar in the imperial kitchen, presided over by the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 季夏祀中霤，設壇乾清宮丹墀，內官主之。

translations.literal: In the last month of summer sacrifice to the Central Drain, with an altar on the cinnabar terrace of the Palace of Heavenly Purity, presided over by inner palace officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the last month of summer sacrifice to the Central Drain on the cinnabar terrace of the Palace of Heavenly Purity, presided over by inner palace officials.

sentences.zh: 孟秋祀門，設壇午門左，司門主之。

translations.literal: In the first month of autumn sacrifice to the Gate, with an altar to the left of the Meridian Gate, presided over by the gate office.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of autumn sacrifice to the Gate at an altar left of the Meridian Gate, presided over by the gate office.

sentences.zh: 孟冬祀井，設壇宮內大庖井前，光祿寺官主之。

translations.literal: In the first month of winter sacrifice to the Well, with an altar before the great kitchen well inside the palace, presided over by an official of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of winter sacrifice to the Well before the great kitchen well inside the palace, presided over by the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 四孟於有事太廟之日，季夏於土旺之日，牲用少牢。

translations.literal: The four first months on days when the Grand Temple had affairs; the last month of summer on the day of earth's dominance; victims use the lesser offering.
translations.idiomatic: The four first months on days when the Grand Temple had business, the last month of summer on the day of earth's dominance, with the lesser offering used.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: " The regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The regulation was approved.

sentences.zh: 從定中霤於奉天殿外文樓前。

translations.literal: It was followed by fixing the Central Drain before the outer tower west of the Hall of Supreme Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Drain altar was fixed before the outer tower west of the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 又歲暮合祭五祀於太廟西廡下，太常寺官行禮。

translations.literal: Also at year-end the Five Sacrifices were jointly offered under the western side hall of the Grand Temple, with officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices performing the rite.
translations.idiomatic: At year-end the Five Sacrifices were also offered jointly under the western side hall of the Grand Temple, performed by officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: ○馬神

translations.literal: ○ The Horse Spirit
translations.idiomatic: The Horse Spirit

sentences.zh: 洪武二年命祭馬祖、先牧、馬社、馬步之神，築壇後湖。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongwu an order commanded sacrifice to the Horse Ancestor, the First Herdsman, the Horse Community, and the Horse Pace spirits, with an altar built at Rear Lake.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Hongwu the court ordered sacrifice to the Horse Ancestor, the First Herdsman, the Horse Community, and the Horse Pace spirits, with an altar built at Rear Lake.

sentences.zh: 禮官言：「《周官》春祭馬祖，天駟星也；

translations.literal: The ritual officials said: "The Offices of Zhou says: in spring sacrifice to the Horse Ancestor, which is the Heavenly Team star;
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials said, "The Offices of Zhou says that in spring one sacrifices to the Horse Ancestor, the Heavenly Team star;

sentences.zh: 夏祭先牧，始養馬者；

translations.literal: in summer sacrifice to the First Herdsman, he who first raised horses;
translations.idiomatic: in summer to the First Herdsman, he who first raised horses;

sentences.zh: 秋祭馬社，始乘馬者；

translations.literal: in autumn sacrifice to the Horse Community, he who first rode horses;"
translations.idiomatic: and in autumn to the Horse Community, he who first rode horses;"

sentences.zh: 冬祭馬步，乃神之災害馬者。

translations.literal: in winter sacrifice to the Horse Pace, which is the spirit that brings calamity upon horses.
translations.idiomatic: and in winter to the Horse Pace, the spirit that brings calamity upon horses.

sentences.zh: 隋用周制，祭以四仲之月。

translations.literal: Sui used the Zhou system, sacrificing in the four mid-season months.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui followed the Zhou system, sacrificing in the four mid-season months.

sentences.zh: 唐、宋因之。

translations.literal: Tang and Song followed it.
translations.idiomatic: Tang and Song followed the same practice.

sentences.zh: 今定春、秋二仲月，甲、戊、庚日，遣官致祀。

translations.literal: Now it is fixed for the two mid-season months of spring and autumn, on jia, wu, and geng days, with officials dispatched to perform sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: It was now fixed for spring and autumn mid-season months on jia, wu, and geng days, with officials dispatched to perform sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 為壇四，樂用時樂，行三獻禮。

translations.literal: Four altars were made, music used the music of the season, and the three-offering rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: Four altars were built, seasonal music was used, and the threefold offering was performed.

sentences.zh: 」四年，蜀明升獻良馬十，其一白者，長丈餘，不可加韉勒。

translations.literal: " In the fourth year Ming Sheng of Shu presented ten fine horses; one was white, more than a zhang in height, and could not be fitted with saddle or bridle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Ming Sheng of Shu presented ten fine horses; one was white, more than ten feet tall, and would not accept saddle or bridle.

sentences.zh: 太祖曰：「天生英物，必有神司之。

translations.literal: The Founder said: "Heaven produces outstanding creatures; there must be a spirit that oversees them.
translations.idiomatic: The Founder said, "Heaven produces extraordinary creatures; there must be a spirit that oversees them.

sentences.zh: 」命太常以少牢祀馬祖，囊沙四百斤壓之，令人騎而遊苑中，久之漸馴。

translations.literal: " He ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to sacrifice to the Horse Ancestor with the lesser offering, packed four hundred jin of sand in a bag to weigh it down, had men ride it roaming in the park, and after a long while it gradually became tame.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to sacrifice to the Horse Ancestor with the lesser offering, packed four hundred jin of sand in sacks to weight the horse, had men ride it about the park, and after some time it gradually grew tame.

sentences.zh: 帝乘之以夕月於清涼山。

translations.literal: The emperor rode it to offer sacrifice to the moon at evening on Cool Breeze Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rode it to perform the evening moon sacrifice on Cool Breeze Mountain.

sentences.zh: 比還，大悅，賜名飛越峯。

translations.literal: When he returned, he was greatly pleased and bestowed the name Soaring Peak.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was greatly pleased and named it Soaring Peak.

sentences.zh: 覆命太常祀馬祖。

translations.literal: He again ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to sacrifice to the Horse Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: He again ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to sacrifice to the Horse Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 五年，並諸神為一壇，歲止春祭。

translations.literal: In the fifth year all spirits were combined on one altar, and each year only the spring sacrifice remained.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year all the spirits were combined on one altar, with only the spring sacrifice each year.

sentences.zh: 永樂十二年，立北京馬神祠於蓮花池。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Yongle the Beijing Horse Spirit Shrine was established at Lotus Pool.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Yongle the Beijing Horse Spirit Shrine was built at Lotus Pond.

sentences.zh: 其南京馬神，則南太僕主之。

translations.literal: As for the Nanjing Horse Spirit, the southern Director of Studs presided.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanjing Horse Spirit was presided over by the southern Director of Studs.

sentences.zh: ○南京神廟

translations.literal: ○ Nanjing Spirit Temples
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing Spirit Temples

sentences.zh: 初稱十廟。

translations.literal: At first they were called the Ten Temples.
translations.idiomatic: They were at first called the Ten Temples.

sentences.zh: 北極真武以三月三日、九月九日，道林真覺普濟禪師寶志以三月十八日，都城隍以八月祭帝王後一日，祠山廣惠張王渤以二月十八日，五顯靈順以四月八日、九月二十八日，皆南京太常寺官祭。

translations.literal: The Northern Pole True Martial on the third day of the third month and the ninth day of the ninth month; the Chan Master Baozhi of Daolin, True Awakening and Universal Salvation, on the eighteenth day of the third month; the Metropolitan City God on the day after the eighth-month sacrifice to emperors; Zhang Wang Bo of Citong Mountain, Broad Beneficence, on the eighteenth day of the second month; the Five Manifestations, Spiritual Compliance, on the eighth day of the fourth month and the twenty-eighth day of the ninth month—all were sacrificed to by officials of the Nanjing Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: The True Martial of the Northern Pole was sacrificed to on the third day of the third month and the ninth day of the ninth month; the Chan Master Baozhi of Daolin, True Awakening and Universal Salvation, on the eighteenth of the third month; the Metropolitan City God on the day after the eighth-month imperial sacrifice; Zhang Wang Bo of Citong Mountain, Broad Beneficence, on the eighteenth of the second month; and the Five Manifestations, Spiritual Compliance, on the eighth of the fourth month and the twenty-eighth of the ninth month—all by officials of the Nanjing Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 漢秣陵尉蔣忠烈公子文、晉成陽卞忠貞公壼、宋濟陽曹武惠王彬、南唐劉忠肅王仁瞻、元衛國忠肅公福壽俱以四孟朔，歲除，應天府官祭。

translations.literal: Jiang Ziwen, Earl of Loyal Splendor and son of the Han Moling Commandant; Bian Kuai, Duke of Loyal Integrity of Jincheng Yang; Cao Bin, King of Martial Grace of Jiyang in Song; Liu Renzhan, King of Loyal Solemnity of Southern Tang; and Fushou, Duke of Loyal Solemnity of the Wei State in Yuan—all on the first days of the four first months and at year-end, with officials of Shuntian Prefecture performing sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Ziwen, son of the Han Moling Commandant and Earl of Loyal Splendor; Bian Kuai, Duke of Loyal Integrity of Jincheng Yang; Cao Bin, King of Martial Grace of Jiyang; Liu Renzhan, King of Loyal Solemnity of Southern Tang; and Fushou, Duke of Loyal Solemnity of the Wei State—all were sacrificed to on the first days of the four first months and at year-end by Shuntian Prefecture officials.

sentences.zh: 惟蔣廟又有四月二十六日之祭。

translations.literal: Only the Jiang Temple also had a sacrifice on the twenty-sixth day of the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Jiang Temple also held a sacrifice on the twenty-sixth of the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 並功臣廟為十一。

translations.literal: Together with the Temple of Meritorious Ministers they made eleven.
translations.idiomatic: Together with the Temple of Meritorious Ministers there were eleven.

sentences.zh: 後復增四：關公廟，洪武二十七年建於雞籠山之陽，稱漢前將軍壽亭侯。

translations.literal: Later four more were added: the Guan Gong Temple, built in the twenty-seventh year of Hongwu on the southern slope of Cock Cage Mountain, styled Former General of Han, Marquis of Shouting.
translations.idiomatic: Four more were later added: the Guan Gong Temple, built in the twenty-seventh year of Hongwu on the southern slope of Cock Cage Mountain and styled Former General of Han, Marquis of Shouting.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十年訂其誤，改稱漢前將軍漢壽亭侯。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Jiajing the error was corrected and it was changed to Former General of Han, Marquis of Han Shouting.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Jiajing the error was corrected to Former General of Han, Marquis of Han Shouting.

sentences.zh: 以四孟歲暮，應天府官祭，五月十三日，南京太常寺官祭。

translations.literal: On the four first months and year-end Shuntian Prefecture officials sacrificed; on the thirteenth day of the fifth month Nanjing Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials sacrificed.
translations.idiomatic: Shuntian Prefecture officials sacrificed on the four first months and at year-end; on the thirteenth of the fifth month Nanjing Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials sacrificed.

sentences.zh: 天妃，永樂七年封為護國庇民妙靈昭應弘仁普濟天妃，以正月十五日、三月二十三日，南京太常寺官祭。

translations.literal: The Heavenly Consort, in the seventh year of Yongle enfeoffed as the Heavenly Consort Protecting the State and Succoring the People, Wondrous Spirit, Manifest Response, Broad Benevolence and Universal Salvation, was sacrificed to on the fifteenth day of the first month and the twenty-third day of the third month by Nanjing Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials.
translations.idiomatic: The Heavenly Consort, enfeoffed in the seventh year of Yongle as Protector of the State and Succorer of the People, Wondrous Spirit of Manifest Response, Broad Benevolence and Universal Salvation, was sacrificed to on the fifteenth of the first month and the twenty-third of the third month by Nanjing Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials.

sentences.zh: 太倉神廟，以仲春、秋望日，南京戶部官祭。

translations.literal: The Great Granary Spirit Temple was sacrificed to on the mid-spring and mid-autumn full-moon days by Nanjing Ministry of Revenue officials.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Granary Spirit Temple was sacrificed to on the mid-spring and mid-autumn full moons by Nanjing Ministry of Revenue officials.

sentences.zh: 司馬、馬祖、先牧神廟，以春、秋仲月中旬，擇日南京太僕寺官祭。

translations.literal: The temples of the Horse Marshal, Horse Ancestor, and First Herdsman—in the middle ten days of spring and autumn mid-season months, on a chosen day Nanjing Director of Studs officials sacrificed.
translations.idiomatic: The Horse Marshal, Horse Ancestor, and First Herdsman temples were sacrificed to on a chosen day within the middle ten days of spring and autumn mid-season months by Nanjing Director of Studs officials.

sentences.zh: 諸廟皆少牢，真武與真覺禪師素羞。

translations.literal: All temples used the lesser offering; True Martial and the True Awakening Chan Master used plain vegetarian offerings.
translations.idiomatic: All temples used the lesser offering; the True Martial and True Awakening Chan Master received plain vegetarian offerings.

sentences.zh: ○功臣廟

translations.literal: ○ Temple of Meritorious Ministers
translations.idiomatic: Temple of Meritorious Ministers

sentences.zh: 太祖既以功臣配享太廟，又命別立廟於雞籠山。

translations.literal: The Founder, having already granted meritorious ministers attendant sacrifice in the Grand Temple, also ordered a separate temple established on Cock Cage Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The Founder, having already granted meritorious ministers attendant sacrifice in the Grand Temple, also ordered a separate temple built on Cock Cage Mountain.

sentences.zh: 論次功臣二十有一人，死者塑像，生者虛其位。

translations.literal: Meritorious ministers were ranked in order, twenty-one in all; for the dead statues were made, for the living their places were left vacant.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-one meritorious ministers were ranked in order; statues were made for the dead, while the living had their places left vacant.

sentences.zh: 正殿：中山武甯王徐達、開平忠武王常遇春、岐陽武靖王李文忠、甯河武順王鄧愈、東甌襄武王湯和、黔甯昭靖王沐英。

translations.literal: Main hall: Prince Martial Tranquility of Zhongshan Xu Da, Prince Loyal Martial of Kaiping Chang Yuchun, Prince Martial Pacification of Qiyang Li Wenzhong, Prince Martial Compliance of Ninghe Deng Yu, Prince Martial Felicity of Dong'ou Tang He, Prince Brilliant Pacification of Qianning Mu Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Main hall: Xu Da, Prince Martial Tranquility of Zhongshan; Chang Yuchun, Prince Loyal Martial of Kaiping; Li Wenzhong, Prince Martial Pacification of Qiyang; Deng Yu, Prince Martial Compliance of Ninghe; Tang He, Prince Martial Felicity of Dong'ou; and Mu Ying, Prince Brilliant Pacification of Qianning.

sentences.zh: 羊二，豕二。

translations.literal: Two sheep and two pigs.
translations.idiomatic: Two sheep and two pigs.

sentences.zh: 西序：越國武莊公胡大海、樑國公趙德勝、巢國武壯公華高、虢國忠烈公俞通海、江國襄烈公吳良、安國忠烈公曹良臣、黔國威毅公吳復、燕山忠湣侯孫興祖。

translations.literal: Western row: Duke Martial Solemnity of Yue Hu Dahai, Duke of Liang Zhao Desheng, Duke Martial Strong of Chao Hua Gao, Duke Loyal Splendor of Guo Yu Tonghai, Duke Martial Felicity of Jiang Wu Liang, Duke Loyal Splendor of An Cao Liangchen, Duke Martial Firmness of Qian Wu Fu, Marquis Loyal Lamentation of Yanshan Sun Xingzu.
translations.idiomatic: Western row: Hu Dahai, Duke Martial Solemnity of Yue; Zhao Desheng, Duke of Liang; Hua Gao, Duke Martial Strong of Chao; Yu Tonghai, Duke Loyal Splendor of Guo; Wu Liang, Duke Martial Felicity of Jiang; Cao Liangchen, Duke Loyal Splendor of An; Wu Fu, Duke Martial Firmness of Qian; and Sun Xingzu, Marquis Loyal Lamentation of Yanshan.

sentences.zh: 東序：郢國公馮國用、西海武壯公耿再成、濟國公丁德興、蔡國忠毅公張德勝、海國襄毅公吳楨、蘄國武義公康茂才、東海郡公茅成。

translations.literal: Eastern row: Duke of Ying Feng Guoyong, Duke Martial Strong of Xihai Geng Zaicheng, Duke of Ji Ding Dexing, Duke Loyal Firmness of Cai Zhang Desheng, Duke Martial Felicity of Hai Wu Zhen, Duke Martial Righteousness of Qi Kang Maocai, Duke of Donghai Mao Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern row: Feng Guoyong, Duke of Ying; Geng Zaicheng, Duke Martial Strong of Xihai; Ding Dexing, Duke of Ji; Zhang Desheng, Duke Loyal Firmness of Cai; Wu Zhen, Duke Martial Felicity of Hai; Kang Maocai, Duke Martial Righteousness of Qi; and Mao Cheng, Duke of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 羊二，豕二。

translations.literal: Two sheep and two pigs.
translations.idiomatic: Two sheep and two pigs.

sentences.zh: 兩廡各設牌一，總書「故指揮千百戶衛所鎮撫之靈」。

translations.literal: Each side hall had one tablet set up, collectively inscribed "Spirits of deceased commanders, company commanders, guard officers, and garrison commissioners."
translations.idiomatic: Each side hall held one tablet inscribed collectively, "Spirits of deceased commanders, company commanders, guard officers, and garrison commissioners."

sentences.zh: 羊十，豕十。

translations.literal: Ten sheep and ten pigs.
translations.idiomatic: Ten sheep and ten pigs.

sentences.zh: 以四孟歲暮，遣駙馬都尉祭。

translations.literal: On the four first months and year-end, an imperial son-in-law was dispatched to sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On the four first months and at year-end an imperial son-in-law was dispatched to perform sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 初，胡大海等歿，命肖像於卞壼、蔣子文之廟。

translations.literal: At first, when Hu Dahai and others died, orders were given for their portraits in the temples of Bian Kuai and Jiang Ziwen.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Hu Dahai and others died, their portraits were ordered placed in the temples of Bian Kuai and Jiang Ziwen.

sentences.zh: 及功臣廟成，移祀焉。

translations.literal: When the Temple of Meritorious Ministers was completed, sacrifice was moved there.
translations.idiomatic: When the Temple of Meritorious Ministers was completed, their worship was moved there.

sentences.zh: 永樂三年，以中山王勳德第一，又命正旦、清明、中元、孟冬、冬至遣太常寺官祭於大功坊之家廟，牲用少牢。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongle, because the Prince of Zhongshan ranked first in merit and virtue, an order was also given that on New Year's Day, Clear and Bright, Mid-Year Ghost Festival, first month of winter, and Winter Solstice Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials should sacrifice at his family temple in Dagong Lane, with victims using the lesser offering.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongle, because the Prince of Zhongshan ranked first in merit, Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials were also ordered to sacrifice at his family temple in Dagong Lane on New Year's Day, Clear and Bright, Mid-Year Ghost Festival, the first month of winter, and Winter Solstice, using the lesser offering.

sentences.zh: ○京師九廟

translations.literal: ○ The Nine Capital Temples
translations.idiomatic: The Nine Capital Temples

sentences.zh: 京師所祭者九廟。

translations.literal: Those sacrificed to in the capital were nine temples.
translations.idiomatic: Nine temples were sacrificed to in the capital.

sentences.zh: 真武廟，永樂十三年建，以祀北極佑聖真君。

translations.literal: The True Martial Temple, built in the thirteenth year of Yongle, was for sacrificing to the Northern Pole Spirit-Aiding Sage True Lord.
translations.idiomatic: The True Martial Temple, built in the thirteenth year of Yongle, sacrificed to the Northern Pole Spirit-Aiding Sage True Lord.

sentences.zh: 正德二年改為靈明顯佑宮，在海子橋之東，祭日同南京。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengde it was changed to the Palace of Spiritual Clarity and Manifest Aid, east of Haizi Bridge, with sacrifice days the same as Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhengde it was renamed the Palace of Spiritual Clarity and Manifest Aid, east of Haizi Bridge, with the same sacrifice days as Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 東嶽泰山廟，在朝陽門外，祭以三月二十八日。

translations.literal: The Eastern Peak Mount Tai Temple stood outside Chaoyang Gate, with sacrifice on the twenty-eighth day of the third month.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Peak Mount Tai Temple stood outside Chaoyang Gate and was sacrificed to on the twenty-eighth of the third month.

sentences.zh: 都城隍廟，祭以五月十一日。

translations.literal: The Metropolitan City God Temple was sacrificed to on the eleventh day of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: The Metropolitan City God Temple was sacrificed to on the eleventh of the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 漢壽亭侯關公廟，永樂間建。

translations.literal: The Guan Gong Temple of Marquis of Han Shouting of Han was built in the Yongle period.
translations.idiomatic: The Guan Gong Temple of the Han Marquis of Han Shouting was built in the Yongle period.

sentences.zh: 成化十三年，又奉敕建廟宛平縣之東，祭以五月十三日。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Chenghua, by imperial command another temple was built east of Wanping County, with sacrifice on the thirteenth day of the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Chenghua another temple was built by imperial command east of Wanping County, with sacrifice on the thirteenth of the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 皆太常寺官祭。

translations.literal: All were sacrificed to by Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials.
translations.idiomatic: All were sacrificed to by Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials.

sentences.zh: 京都太倉神廟，建於太倉，戶部官祭。

translations.literal: The capital Great Granary Spirit Temple was built at the great granary, with Ministry of Revenue officials sacrificing.
translations.idiomatic: The capital Great Granary Spirit Temple was built at the great granary and sacrificed to by Ministry of Revenue officials.

sentences.zh: 司馬、馬祖、先牧神廟，太僕寺官祭。

translations.literal: The temples of the Horse Marshal, Horse Ancestor, and First Herdsman were sacrificed to by Director of Studs officials.
translations.idiomatic: The Horse Marshal, Horse Ancestor, and First Herdsman temples were sacrificed to by Director of Studs officials.

sentences.zh: 宋文丞相祠，永樂六年從太常博士劉履節請，建於順天府學之西。

translations.literal: The Shrine of Chancellor Wen of Song, in the sixth year of Yongle following the request of Court of Imperial Sacrifices erudite Liu Lüjie, was built west of the Shuntian Prefecture school.
translations.idiomatic: The Shrine of Chancellor Wen of Song was built west of the Shuntian Prefecture school in the sixth year of Yongle at the request of Court of Imperial Sacrifices erudite Liu Lüjie.

sentences.zh: 元世祖廟，嘉靖中罷。

translations.literal: The temple of the Yuan Founder was discontinued in the Jiajing period.
translations.idiomatic: The temple of the Yuan Founder was discontinued in the Jiajing period.

sentences.zh: 皆以二月，八月中旬順天府官祭。

translations.literal: Both were sacrificed to in the second month and the middle ten days of the eighth month by Shuntian Prefecture officials.
translations.idiomatic: Both were sacrificed to in the second month and the middle ten days of the eighth month by Shuntian Prefecture officials.

sentences.zh: 洪恩靈濟宮，祀徐知證、知諤。

translations.literal: The Palace of Vast Grace and Spiritual Succor sacrificed to Xu Zhizheng and Xu Zhi'e.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace of Vast Grace and Spiritual Succor sacrificed to Xu Zhizheng and Xu Zhi'e.

sentences.zh: 永樂十五年，立廟皇城之西，正旦、冬至聖節，內閣禮部及內官各一員祭。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Yongle a temple was established west of the imperial city; on New Year's Day and the Winter Solstice imperial festival days, one member each from the Grand Secretariat, Ministry of Rites, and inner service sacrificed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Yongle a temple was built west of the imperial city; on New Year's Day and the Winter Solstice imperial festival, one official each from the Grand Secretariat, Ministry of Rites, and inner service performed sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 生辰，禮部官祭。

translations.literal: On the birthday, Ministry of Rites officials sacrificed.
translations.idiomatic: On the birthday Ministry of Rites officials performed sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 弘治中，大學士劉健等請毋遣閣臣。

translations.literal: In the Hongzhi period Grand Secretary Liu Jian and others requested that grand secretaries not be dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongzhi period Grand Secretary Liu Jian and others asked that grand secretaries no longer be dispatched.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中，改遣太常寺官。

translations.literal: In the Jiajing period, Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials were dispatched instead.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiajing period Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials were dispatched instead.

sentences.zh: 其榮國公姚廣孝，洪熙元年從祀太廟。

translations.literal: As for Duke of Glory State Yao Guangxiao, in the first year of Hongxi he received attendant sacrifice in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Glory State Yao Guangxiao received attendant sacrifice in the Grand Temple in the first year of Hongxi.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖九年撤廟祀，移祀大興隆寺，在皇城西北隅。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Jiajing temple sacrifice was withdrawn and sacrifice moved to the Great Prosperity Monastery in the northwest corner of the imperial city.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Jiajing his temple sacrifice was withdrawn and worship moved to the Great Prosperity Monastery in the northwest corner of the imperial city.

sentences.zh: 後寺毀，復移崇國寺。

translations.literal: Later when the monastery was destroyed, sacrifice was again moved to the Chongguo Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: When the monastery was later destroyed, worship was moved again to the Chongguo Monastery.

sentences.zh: 東嶽、都城隍用太牢，五廟用少牢，真武、靈濟宮素羞。

translations.literal: The Eastern Peak and Metropolitan City God used the greater offering; five temples used the lesser offering; True Martial and the Palace of Spiritual Succor used plain vegetarian offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Peak and Metropolitan City God received the greater offering; five temples the lesser offering; and the True Martial and Palace of Spiritual Succor plain vegetarian offerings.

sentences.zh: ○諸神祠

translations.literal: ○ Shrines to Various Spirits
translations.idiomatic: Shrines to Various Spirits

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，命中書省下郡縣，訪求應祀神祇。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu an order was sent to the Secretariat to dispatch to prefectures and counties to seek out spirits that ought to be sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu the Secretariat was ordered to have prefectures and counties seek out spirits worthy of sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 名山大川、聖帝明王、忠臣烈士，凡有功於國家及惠愛在民者，著於祀典，令有司歲時致祭。

translations.literal: Famous mountains and great rivers, sage emperors and enlightened kings, loyal ministers and martyrs—all who had merit for the state or kindness and love among the people—were entered in the sacrificial canon, with orders that responsible officials perform sacrifice at the seasons.
translations.idiomatic: Famous mountains and great rivers, sage emperors and enlightened kings, loyal ministers and martyrs—all who had served the state or shown kindness to the people—were entered in the sacrificial canon, and responsible officials were ordered to sacrifice at the proper seasons.

sentences.zh: 二年，又詔天下神祇，常有功德於民，事蹟昭著者，雖不致祭，禁人毀撤祠宇。

translations.literal: In the second year another edict to spirits throughout the realm said that those who constantly had merit for the people and whose deeds were illustrious, even if sacrifice was not performed to them, it was forbidden for people to destroy or remove their shrine buildings.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year another edict declared that spirits throughout the realm who had long shown merit to the people and whose deeds were illustrious, even if not formally sacrificed to, might not have their shrines destroyed or removed.

sentences.zh: 三年，定諸神封號，凡後世溢美之稱皆革去。

translations.literal: In the third year the enfeoffment titles of various spirits were fixed, and all posthumous flattering designations of later ages were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the enfeoffment titles of various spirits were fixed, and all later extravagant honorifics were abolished.

sentences.zh: 天下神祠不應祀典者，即淫祠也，有司毋得致祭。

translations.literal: Spirit shrines throughout the realm that did not accord with the sacrificial canon were licentious shrines, and responsible officials might not perform sacrifice to them.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit shrines throughout the realm that did not accord with the sacrificial canon were licentious shrines, and officials might not sacrifice to them.

sentences.zh: 弘治元年，禮科張九功言：「祀典正則人心正。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongzhi Zhang Jiugong of the Rites Section said: "When the sacrificial canon is correct, people's hearts are correct.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongzhi Zhang Jiugong of the Rites Section said, "When the sacrificial canon is correct, the people's hearts are correct.

sentences.zh: 今朝廷常祭之外，又有釋迦牟尼文佛、三清三境九天應元雷聲普化天尊、金玉闕真君元君、神父神母，諸宮觀中又有水官星君、諸天諸帝之祭，非所以法天下。

translations.literal: Now beyond the court's regular sacrifices there are also sacrifice to Shakyamuni the Cultured Buddha, the Three Pure Ones of the Three Realms and the Nine Heavens Thunderclap Universal Transformation Heavenly Lord, the True Lords of the Golden Jade Portal, the Spirit Father and Spirit Mother, and in the various palaces and abbeys also sacrifice to the Water Star Lord and the various heavens and various emperors—this is not how to set an example for all under Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: Yet beyond the court's regular sacrifices there are also sacrifices to Shakyamuni the Cultured Buddha, the Three Pure Ones and the Nine Heavens Thunderclap Universal Transformation Heavenly Lord, the True Lords of the Golden Jade Portal, the Spirit Father and Spirit Mother, and in various palaces and abbeys to the Water Star Lord and the lords of heaven—this is not how to set an example for the realm."

sentences.zh: 」帝下其章禮部，尚書周洪謨等言：

translations.literal: " The emperor sent his memorial down to the Ministry of Rites, and Minister Zhou Hongmo and others said:
translations.idiomatic: The emperor referred the memorial to the Ministry of Rites, and Minister Zhou Hongmo and others replied:

sentences.zh: 釋迦牟尼文佛生西方中天竺國。

translations.literal: Shakyamuni the Cultured Buddha was born in Central India in the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Shakyamuni the Cultured Buddha was born in Central India in the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 宗其教者，以本性為法身，德業為報身，並真身為三，其實一人耳。

translations.literal: Those who honor his teaching take intrinsic nature as the dharma body, merit and achievement as the reward body, and together with the true body make three, but in reality it is one person.
translations.idiomatic: His followers take intrinsic nature as the dharma body and merit and achievement as the reward body, making three bodies together with the true body—but in reality they are one person.

sentences.zh: 道家以老子為師。

translations.literal: The Daoist school takes Laozi as teacher.
translations.idiomatic: The Daoist school takes Laozi as its teacher.

sentences.zh: 硃熹有曰：「玉清元始天尊既非老子法身，上清太上道君又非老子報身，設有二像，又非與老子為一。

translations.literal: Zhu Xi has said: "The Jade Pure Primordial Heavenly Lord is neither Laozi's dharma body, nor is the Upper Pure Supreme Dao Lord his reward body; even if there are two images, they are again not one with Laozi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xi wrote, "The Jade Pure Primordial Heavenly Lord is not Laozi's dharma body, and the Upper Pure Supreme Dao Lord is not his reward body; even if there are two images, they are not one with Laozi.

sentences.zh: 而老子又自為上清太上老君，蓋仿釋氏而又失之者也。

translations.literal: Yet Laozi again made himself the Upper Pure Supreme Laojun—this imitates the Buddhist school yet errs in doing so."
translations.idiomatic: Yet Laozi was also made the Upper Pure Supreme Laojun—an imitation of Buddhism that went astray."

sentences.zh: 」自今凡遇萬壽等節，不令修建吉祥齋醮，或遇喪禮，不令修建薦揚齋醮。

translations.literal: " From now on whenever Longevity and other festivals occur, auspicious fasting rites are not to be built; when funeral rites occur, memorial elevation fasting rites are not to be built.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth on Longevity and other festivals auspicious fasting rites are not to be held, and on occasions of mourning memorial elevation rites are not to be held.

sentences.zh: 其大興隆寺、朝天宮俱停遣官祭告。

translations.literal: At the Great Prosperity Monastery and the Palace Facing Heaven, dispatch of officials for sacrificial announcement was altogether stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatch of officials for sacrificial announcement at the Great Prosperity Monastery and the Palace Facing Heaven was altogether stopped.

sentences.zh: 北極中天星主紫微大帝者，北極五星在紫微垣中，正統初，建紫微殿，設像祭告。

translations.literal: The Northern Pole Central Heaven Star Lord Purple Subtlety Great Emperor—the five stars of the Northern Pole are within the Purple Subtlety Enclosure; at the beginning of Zhengtong the Purple Subtlety Hall was built, with images set up for sacrificial announcement.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Pole Central Heaven Star Lord, the Purple Subtlety Great Emperor—the five stars of the Northern Pole lie within the Purple Subtlety Enclosure; at the beginning of Zhengtong the Purple Subtlety Hall was built with images set up for sacrificial announcement.

sentences.zh: 夫幽禜祭星，古禮也。

translations.literal: Now yin sacrifice to the stars is ancient rite.
translations.idiomatic: Yin sacrifice to the stars is ancient rite.

sentences.zh: 今乃像之如人，稱之為帝，稽之祀典，誠無所據。

translations.literal: Now they are imaged like humans and called emperors; examining the sacrificial canon, there is truly no basis.
translations.idiomatic: To image them like humans and call them emperors has no basis in the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 雷聲普化天尊者，道家以為總司五雷，又以六月二十四日為天尊示現之日，故歲以是日遣官詣顯靈宮致祭。

translations.literal: The Thunderclap Universal Transformation Heavenly Lord—the Daoist school considers him general overseer of the Five Thunders, and also takes the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month as the day the Heavenly Lord manifested, hence each year on that day officials are dispatched to the Palace of Manifest Spirit to perform sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The Thunderclap Universal Transformation Heavenly Lord—the Daoists consider him overseer of the Five Thunders, and take the twenty-fourth of the sixth month as the day of his manifestation, so each year officials are dispatched to the Palace of Manifest Spirit to sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 夫風雲雷雨，南郊合祀，而山川壇復有秋報，則此祭亦當罷免。

translations.literal: Now wind, cloud, thunder, and rain are jointly sacrificed to at the southern suburb, and the Altars of Mountains and Rivers also have autumn thanksgiving, so this sacrifice should also be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Wind, cloud, thunder, and rain are already sacrificed to jointly at the southern suburb, and the Altars of Mountains and Rivers also have autumn thanksgiving, so this sacrifice should be abolished as well.

sentences.zh: 祖師三天扶教輔玄大法師真君者，傳記云：「漢張道陵，善以符治病。

translations.literal: The Patriarchal Master of the Three Heavens Supporting the Teaching and Assisting the Mysterious Great Dharma Master True Lord—biographies say: "Zhang Daoling of Han was skilled at using talismans to treat illness.
translations.idiomatic: The Patriarchal Master of the Three Heavens, Supporting the Teaching and Assisting the Mysterious Great Dharma Master True Lord—biographies say, "Zhang Daoling of Han was skilled at using talismans to treat illness.

sentences.zh: 唐天寶，宋熙甯、大觀間，累號正一靖應真君，子孫亦有封號。

translations.literal: In Tang Tianbao and in Song Xining and Daguan periods he was repeatedly titled True Lord of Orthodox Unity and Tranquil Response; descendants also received enfeoffment titles.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang Tianbao and in Song Xining and Daguan he was repeatedly titled True Lord of Orthodox Unity and Tranquil Response, and his descendants also received enfeoffment titles.

sentences.zh: 國朝仍襲正一嗣教真人之封。

translations.literal: Our dynasty still inherits the enfeoffment of True Man of Orthodox Unity and Succession to the Teaching.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty still inherits the enfeoffment of True Man of Orthodox Unity and Succession to the Teaching.

sentences.zh: 」然宋邵伯溫云：「張魯祖陵、父衡，以符法相授受，自號師君。

translations.literal: " Yet Song Shao Bowen said: "Zhang Lu's ancestor Ling and father Heng transmitted talisman methods to one another and called themselves Master Lords.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Song Shao Bowen wrote, "Zhang Lu's ancestor Ling and father Heng transmitted talisman methods to one another and styled themselves Master Lords.

sentences.zh: 」今歲以正月十五日為陵生日，遣官詣顯靈宮祭告，亦非祀典。

translations.literal: " Now each year the fifteenth day of the first month is taken as Ling's birthday, and officials are dispatched to the Palace of Manifest Spirit for sacrificial announcement—this too is not in the sacrificial canon.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the fifteenth of the first month is now taken as Ling's birthday and officials are dispatched to the Palace of Manifest Spirit to announce sacrifice—this too is not in the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 大小青龍神者，記云：「有僧名盧，寓西山。

translations.literal: The Greater and Lesser Azure Dragon Spirits—records say: "There was a monk named Lu who lodged on Western Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The Greater and Lesser Azure Dragon Spirits—records say, "A monk named Lu lodged on Western Mountain.

sentences.zh: 有二童子來侍。

translations.literal: Two youths came to attend him.
translations.idiomatic: Two youths came to attend him.

sentences.zh: 時久旱，童子入潭化二青龍，遂得雨。

translations.literal: At the time there was long drought; the youths entered a pool and transformed into two azure dragons, and rain was obtained.
translations.idiomatic: During a long drought the youths entered a pool and transformed into two azure dragons, and rain followed.

sentences.zh: 後賜盧號曰感應禪師，建寺設像，別設龍祠於潭上。

translations.literal: Later Lu was granted the title Responsive Chan Master, a monastery was built and images set up, and a separate dragon shrine was established above the pool.
translations.idiomatic: Lu was later granted the title Responsive Chan Master; a monastery was built with images set up, and a separate dragon shrine was established above the pool.

sentences.zh: 宣德中，建大圓通寺，加二龍封號，春秋祭之。

translations.literal: In the Xuande period the Great Perfect Penetration Monastery was built, the two dragons were given enfeoffment titles, and they were sacrificed to in spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xuande period the Great Perfect Penetration Monastery was built, the two dragons were given enfeoffment titles, and sacrifice was performed in spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 」邇者連旱，祈禱無應，不足崇奉明矣。

translations.literal: " Recently there has been continuous drought and prayer has had no response—the insufficiency of honoring them is clear.
translations.idiomatic: Recently there has been continuous drought and prayer has gone unanswered—the futility of honoring them is clear.

sentences.zh: 梓潼帝君者，記云：「神姓張，名亞子，居蜀七曲山。

translations.literal: The Zitong Imperial Lord—records say: "The spirit's surname was Zhang, his name Yazi, and he dwelt on Seven Bend Mountain in Shu.
translations.idiomatic: The Zitong Imperial Lord—records say, "The spirit's surname was Zhang, his name Yazi, and he dwelt on Seven Bend Mountain in Shu.

sentences.zh: 仕晉戰沒，人為立廟。

translations.literal: He served Jin and died in battle; people built a temple for him.
translations.idiomatic: He served Jin and died in battle, and people built a temple for him.

sentences.zh: 唐、宋屢封至英顯王。

translations.literal: Tang and Song repeatedly enfeoffed him up to King of Heroic Manifestation.
translations.idiomatic: Tang and Song repeatedly enfeoffed him, ultimately as King of Heroic Manifestation.

sentences.zh: 道家謂帝命梓潼掌文昌府事及人間祿籍，故元加號為帝君，而天下學校亦有祠祀者。

translations.literal: The Daoist school says the Emperor ordered Zitong to oversee the affairs of the Palace of Literary Glory and the registers of human emolument, hence Yuan added the title Imperial Lord, and schools throughout the realm also have shrines sacrificing to him.
translations.idiomatic: The Daoists say the Emperor ordered Zitong to oversee the Palace of Literary Glory and the registers of human emolument, so Yuan added the title Imperial Lord, and schools throughout the realm also maintain shrines to him.

sentences.zh: 景泰中，因京師舊廟闢而新之，歲以二月三日生辰，遣祭。

translations.literal: In the Jingtai period, because the old temple in the capital was expanded and made new, each year on the second month third day, his birthday, sacrifice was dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jingtai period the old capital temple was expanded and rebuilt; each year on the third day of the second month, his birthday, envoys were sent to sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 」夫梓潼顯靈於蜀，廟食其地為宜。

translations.literal: " Now Zitong manifests his spirit in Shu; a temple receiving offerings in that land is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Zitong manifests his power in Shu; it is fitting that his temple receive offerings there alone.

sentences.zh: 文昌六星與之無涉，宜敕罷免。

translations.literal: The six stars of Wenchang have nothing to do with him; an imperial order to abolish is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: The six stars of Wenchang have no connection with him; he should be abolished by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 其祠在天下學校者，俱令拆毀。

translations.literal: Shrines to him in schools throughout the realm should all be ordered demolished.
translations.idiomatic: Shrines to him in schools throughout the realm should all be torn down.

sentences.zh: 北極佑聖真君者，乃玄武七宿，後人以為真君，作龜蛇於其下。

translations.literal: The Northern Pole Spirit-Aiding Sage True Lord is the seven mansions of the Black Tortoise; later people took him for a True Lord and placed turtle and serpent beneath him.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Pole Spirit-Aiding Sage True Lord is in origin the seven mansions of the Black Tortoise; later ages made him a True Lord and set turtle and serpent figures beneath him.

sentences.zh: 宋真宗避諱，改為真武。

translations.literal: Song Zhenzong avoided the taboo character and changed it to True Martial.
translations.idiomatic: Song Zhenzong avoided the taboo character and renamed him True Martial.

sentences.zh: 靖康初，加號佑聖助順靈應真君。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingkang, the title Spirit-Aiding Assisting-Compliance Spirit-Responding True Lord was added.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jingkang era he was given the added title Spirit-Aiding, Assisting-Compliance, Spirit-Responding True Lord.

sentences.zh: 圖志云：「真武為淨樂王太子，修煉武當山，功成飛升。

translations.literal: Chart records say: "True Martial was the crown prince of the King of Pure Joy, cultivated on Mount Wudang, and upon achievement of the work flew aloft.
translations.idiomatic: Illustrated gazetteers say, "True Martial was crown prince of the King of Pure Joy; he cultivated on Mount Wudang and, his work complete, ascended.

sentences.zh: 奉上帝命鎮北方。

translations.literal: By the Supreme Emperor's command he guards the north.
translations.idiomatic: By the Supreme Emperor's command he guards the north.

sentences.zh: 被髮跣足，建皁纛玄旗。

translations.literal: With hair unbound and feet bare, he raised black banners and dark flags.
translations.idiomatic: With hair unbound and feet bare, he raised black banners and dark pennants.

sentences.zh: 」此道家附會之說。

translations.literal: " These are Daoist fabricated explanations.
translations.idiomatic: These are Daoist fabrications grafted onto the stars.

sentences.zh: 國朝御製碑謂，太祖平定天下，陰佑為多，當建廟南京崇祀。

translations.literal: The dynasty's imperially composed stele says that when the Taizu pacified the realm, covert aid was ample, and a temple should be built at Nanjing for exalted sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial stele of our dynasty says that when the Taizu pacified the realm, covert aid was abundant and a temple should be raised at Nanjing for exalted sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 及太宗靖難，以神有顯相功，又於京城艮隅並武當山重建廟宇。

translations.literal: When the Taizong quelled the turmoil, because the spirit had manifest merit, temples were again built at the Gen corner of the capital and on Mount Wudang.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizong quelled the succession struggle, because the spirit had shown manifest merit, temples were rebuilt at the capital's northeast corner and on Mount Wudang.

sentences.zh: 兩京歲時朔望各遣官致祭，而武當山又專官督祀事。

translations.literal: Both capitals each year at the new and full moon dispatched officials to perform sacrifice, while Mount Wudang also had a dedicated official supervising sacrificial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Both capitals dispatched officials at each new and full moon throughout the year, while Mount Wudang had a dedicated officer overseeing sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 憲宗嘗範金為像。

translations.literal: Xianzong once cast a gilt image.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong once had a gilt image cast.

sentences.zh: 今請止遵洪武間例，每年三月三日、九月九日用素羞，遣太常官致祭，餘皆停免。

translations.literal: Now it is requested to stop at following only the Hongwu-period precedent: each year on the third day of the third month and ninth day of the ninth month use plain vegetarian offerings and dispatch Court of Imperial Sacrifices officials to sacrifice; all else should be suspended.
translations.idiomatic: It is now proposed to follow only the Hongwu precedent: on the third day of the third month and the ninth day of the ninth month each year, plain vegetarian offerings should be sent with Court of Imperial Sacrifices officers to sacrifice, and all other rites suspended.

sentences.zh: 崇恩真君、隆恩真君者，道家以崇恩姓薩名堅，西蜀人，宋徽宗時嘗從王侍宸、林靈素輩學法有驗。

translations.literal: The True Lords of Honored Grace and Profound Grace—the Daoist school says Honored Grace, surname Sa, given name Jian, a man of western Shu, in Song Huizong's time once studied methods with Wang Shichen, Lin Lingsu and company and had efficacy.
translations.idiomatic: The True Lords of Honored Grace and Profound Grace—the Daoists identify Honored Grace as Sa Jian of western Shu, who in Huizong's reign studied ritual methods with Wang Shichen, Lin Lingsu, and others with proven results.

sentences.zh: 隆恩，則玉樞火府天將王靈官也，又嘗從薩傳符法。

translations.literal: Profound Grace is the Jade Pivot Fire Bureau Heaven General Wang Lingguan, who also once received talisman methods from Sa.
translations.idiomatic: Profound Grace is Wang Lingguan, Heaven General of the Jade Pivot Fire Bureau, who also received talisman methods from Sa.

sentences.zh: 永樂中，以道士周思得能傳靈官法，乃於禁城之西建天將廟及祖師殿。

translations.literal: In Yongle, because the Daoist Zhou Side could transmit Lingguan's methods, thereupon west of the Forbidden City the Heaven General Temple and Patriarch Hall were built.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle, because the Daoist Zhou Side could transmit Lingguan's methods, a Heaven General Temple and Patriarch Hall were built west of the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 宣德中，改大德觀，封二真君。

translations.literal: In Xuande it was changed to the Great Virtue Abbey and the two True Lords were enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande it was renamed the Great Virtue Abbey and both were enfeoffed as True Lords.

sentences.zh: 成化初改顯靈宮。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chenghua it was changed to the Palace of Manifest Spirit.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chenghua it was renamed the Palace of Manifest Spirit.

sentences.zh: 每年換袍服，所費不訾。

translations.literal: Every year robes were replaced, at cost beyond reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: Robes were replaced every year at incalculable expense.

sentences.zh: 近今祈禱無應，亦當罷免。

translations.literal: Recently prayer has had no response; this too should be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Prayer of late has gone unanswered; this cult too should be abolished.

sentences.zh: 金闕上帝、玉闕上帝者，志云：「閩縣靈濟宮祀五代時徐溫子知證、知諤。

translations.literal: The Golden Portal Emperor and Jade Portal Emperor—records say: "The Min County Palace of Spiritual Succor sacrifices to Xu Wen's sons Zhizheng and Zhie of Five Dynasties times.
translations.idiomatic: The Golden Portal Emperor and Jade Portal Emperor—records say, "The Palace of Spiritual Succor in Min County sacrifices to Xu Wen's sons Zhizheng and Zhie of the Five Dynasties.

sentences.zh: 國朝御製碑謂太宗嘗弗豫，禱神輒應，因大新閩地廟宇，春秋致祭。

translations.literal: The dynasty's imperially composed stele says the Taizong once was unwell, prayed to the spirit and it responded at once; therefore the Fujian temple was greatly renewed, and sacrifice in spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial stele of our dynasty says the Taizong once fell ill, prayed to the spirit, and was answered at once; the Fujian temple was therefore greatly rebuilt and sacrifice offered in spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 又立廟京師，加封金闕真君、玉闕真君。

translations.literal: A temple was also established at the capital and they were enfeoffed as Golden Portal True Lord and Jade Portal True Lord.
translations.idiomatic: A temple was also raised in the capital, and they were enfeoffed as Golden Portal True Lord and Jade Portal True Lord.

sentences.zh: 正統、成化中，累加號為上帝。

translations.literal: In Zhengtong and Chenghua, titles were repeatedly augmented to Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong and Chenghua their titles were repeatedly augmented until they were called Emperors.

sentences.zh: 朔望令節俱遣官祀，及時薦新，四時換袍服。

translations.literal: At new and full moons and festival days officials were all dispatched to sacrifice, seasonal offerings of new produce were made, and robes were changed four times a year.
translations.idiomatic: At each new and full moon and festival day officials were dispatched to sacrifice; fresh offerings were presented in season and robes were changed four times a year.

sentences.zh: 」夫神世系事蹟，本非甚異，其僭號宜革正，妄費亦宜節省。

translations.literal: " The spirit's genealogy and deeds through the ages are not very extraordinary; their usurping titles should be rectified, and wasteful expenditure should also be economized.
translations.idiomatic: Their genealogy and deeds are hardly extraordinary; their presumptuous titles should be corrected and wasteful expenditure curtailed.

sentences.zh: 神父聖帝、神母元君及金玉闕元君者，即二徐父母及其配也。

translations.literal: Spirit Father Holy Emperor, Spirit Mother Primal Lady, and Golden and Jade Portal Primal Ladies are precisely the two Xus' parents and their consorts.
translations.idiomatic: The Spirit Father Holy Emperor, Spirit Mother Primal Lady, and Golden and Jade Portal Primal Ladies are none other than the two Xus' parents and their wives.

sentences.zh: 宋封其父齊王為忠武真人，母田氏為仁壽仙妃，配皆為仙妃。

translations.literal: Song enfeoffed their father Prince Qi as True Man of Loyal Martial bearing, their mother Lady Tian as Immortal Consort of Benevolent Longevity, and consorts all as Immortal Consorts.
translations.idiomatic: Song enfeoffed their father, Prince of Qi, as True Man of Loyal Martial bearing, their mother Lady Tian as Immortal Consort of Benevolent Longevity, and all consorts as Immortal Consorts.

sentences.zh: 永樂至成化間，屢加封今號，亦宜削號罷祀。

translations.literal: From Yongle through Chenghua, titles were repeatedly augmented to the present designations; these too should have titles stripped and sacrifice abolished.
translations.idiomatic: From Yongle through Chenghua titles were repeatedly augmented to their present forms; these too should be stripped of rank and removed from sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 東嶽泰山之神者，泰山五嶽首，廟在泰安州山下。

translations.literal: The spirit of Mount Tai of the Eastern Peak—Mount Tai is head of the five peaks; the temple is at the foot of the mountain in Taian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit of Mount Tai, the Eastern Peak—Mount Tai stands first among the five peaks; its temple lies at the foot of the mountain in Taian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又每歲南郊及山川壇俱有合祭之禮。

translations.literal: Moreover, each year at the southern suburban altar and the mountains-and-rivers altar there are joint sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, each year the southern suburban altar and the mountains-and-rivers altar already include joint sacrifices to it.

sentences.zh: 今朝陽門外有元東嶽舊廟，國朝因而不廢。

translations.literal: Now outside Chaoyang Gate in the capital there is the old Eastern Peak temple of Yuan; the dynasty has not abolished it.
translations.idiomatic: Today outside Chaoyang Gate stands Yuan's old Eastern Peak temple, which our dynasty has left standing.

sentences.zh: 夫既專祭封內，且合祭郊壇，則此廟之祭，實為煩瀆。

translations.literal: Since there is already dedicated sacrifice within the fief and joint sacrifice at the suburban altar, sacrifice at this temple is truly redundant offense.
translations.idiomatic: Since there is already dedicated sacrifice within its domain and joint sacrifice at the suburban altars, sacrifice at this temple is truly redundant and profane.

sentences.zh: 京師都城隍之神者，舊在順天府西南，以五月十一日為神誕辰，故是日及節令皆遣官祀。

translations.literal: The spirit of the capital's metropolitan city god—formerly in the southwest of Shuntian Prefecture, with the eleventh day of the fifth month as the spirit's birthday, and therefore on that day and at festival seasons officials were dispatched to sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: The capital's metropolitan city god—formerly housed in the southwest of Shuntian Prefecture, with the eleventh day of the fifth month observed as his birthday, so that on that day and at festival seasons officials were sent to sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 夫城隍之神，非人鬼也，安有誕辰？

translations.literal: The city god spirit is not human ghost; how could there be a birthday?
translations.idiomatic: The city god is no human ghost—how could he have a birthday?

sentences.zh: 況南郊秋祀俱已合祭，則誕辰及節令之祀非宜，凡此俱當罷免。

translations.literal: Moreover southern suburban autumn sacrifice already includes joint sacrifice; birthday and festival-season sacrifices are inappropriate—all these should be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the southern suburban autumn rites already include him in joint sacrifice; birthday and festival observances are inappropriate, and all of these should be abolished.

sentences.zh: 議上，乃命修建齋醮，遣官祭告，並東嶽、真武、城隍廟、靈濟宮祭祀，俱仍舊。

translations.literal: When the deliberation was submitted, the emperor then ordered construction of fasting rites, dispatch of officials for sacrificial announcement, and sacrifice at the Eastern Peak, True Martial, City God Temple, and Palace of Spiritual Succor—all remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: When the deliberation was submitted, the emperor ordered fasting rites built and officials dispatched to announce sacrifice; sacrifice at the Eastern Peak, True Martial, City God Temple, and Palace of Spiritual Succor all remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 二徐真君及其父母妻革去帝號，仍舊封，冠袍等物換回焚毀，餘如所議行之。

translations.literal: The two Xu True Lords and their parents and wives had the Emperor titles removed but retained former enfeoffments; caps and robes and such objects were exchanged back and burned; the remainder was carried out as deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: The two Xu True Lords and their parents and wives were stripped of the title Emperor but kept their former enfeoffments; caps, robes, and the like were recalled and burned; the rest was carried out as proposed.

sentences.zh: 按祀典，太祖時，應天祀陳喬、楊邦乂、姚興、王鉷，成都祀李冰、文翁、張詠，均州祀黃霸，密縣祀卓茂，松江祀陸遜、陸抗、陸凱，龍州祀李龍遷，建甯祀謝夷甫，彭澤祀狄仁傑，九江祀李黼，安慶祀餘闕、韓建之、李宗可。

translations.literal: Examining the sacrificial canon, in Taizu times: Yingtian sacrificed to Chen Qiao, Yang Bangyi, Yao Xing, and Wang Hong; Chengdu to Li Bing, Wen Weng, and Zhang Yong; Junzhou to Huang Ba; Mi County to Zhuo Mao; Songjiang to Lu Xun, Lu Kang, and Lu Kai; Longzhou to Li Longqian; Jianning to Xie Yifu; Pengze to Di Renjie; Jiujiang to Li Fu; Anqing to Yu Que, Han Jianzhi, and Li Zongke.
translations.idiomatic: According to the sacrificial canon, under the Taizu: Yingtian sacrificed to Chen Qiao, Yang Bangyi, Yao Xing, and Wang Hong; Chengdu to Li Bing, Wen Weng, and Zhang Yong; Junzhou to Huang Ba; Mi County to Zhuo Mao; Songjiang to Lu Xun, Lu Kang, and Lu Kai; Longzhou to Li Longqian; Jianning to Xie Yifu; Pengze to Di Renjie; Jiujiang to Li Fu; and Anqing to Yu Que, Han Jianzhi, and Li Zongke.

sentences.zh: 宣宗時，高郵祀耿遇德。

translations.literal: In Xuande times, Gaoyou sacrificed to Geng Yude.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Xuande Emperor, Gaoyou sacrificed to Geng Yude.

sentences.zh: 英宗時，豫章祀韋丹、許遜，無錫祀張巡。

translations.literal: In Yingzong times, Yuzhang sacrificed to Wei Dan and Xu Xun, Wuxi to Zhang Xun.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yingzong Emperor, Yuzhang sacrificed to Wei Dan and Xu Xun, and Wuxi to Zhang Xun.

sentences.zh: 憲宗時，崖山祀張世傑、陸秀夫。

translations.literal: In Xianzong times, Yashan sacrificed to Zhang Shijie and Lu Xiufu.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Xianzong Emperor, Yashan sacrificed to Zhang Shijie and Lu Xiufu.

sentences.zh: 孝宗時，新會祀宋慈元楊後，延平祀羅從彥、李侗，建甯祀劉子翬，烏撒祀潭淵，廬陵祀文天祥，婺源祀硃熹，都昌祀陳澔，饒州祀江萬里，福州祀陳文龍，興化祀陳瓚，湖廣祀李芾，廣西祀馬慨。

translations.literal: In Xiaozong times, Xinhui sacrificed to Empress Yang of Song Ciyuan, Yanping to Luo Congyan and Li Tong, Jianning to Liu Ziqian, Wusa to Tan Yuan, Luling to Wen Tianxiang, Wuyuan to Zhu Xi, Duchang to Chen Hao, Raozhou to Jiang Wanli, Fuzhou to Chen Wenlong, Xinghua to Chen Zan, Huguang to Li Fu, Guangxi to Ma Kai.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Xiaozong Emperor, Xinhui sacrificed to Empress Yang of Song's Ciyuan reign, Yanping to Luo Congyan and Li Tong, Jianning to Liu Ziqian, Wusa to Tan Yuan, Luling to Wen Tianxiang, Wuyuan to Zhu Xi, Duchang to Chen Hao, Raozhou to Jiang Wanli, Fuzhou to Chen Wenlong, Xinghua to Chen Zan, Huguang to Li Fu, and Guangxi to Ma Kai.
