sentences.zh: 武宗時，真定祀顏杲卿、真卿，韶州附祀張九齡子拯，沂州祀諸葛亮，蕭山祀遊酢、羅從彥。

translations.literal: In Wuzong times, Zhending sacrificed to Yan Gaoqing and Yan Zhenqing, Shaozhou ancillary sacrifice to Zhang Jiuling's son Zheng, Yizhou to Zhuge Liang, Xiaoshan to You Zuo and Luo Congyan.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Wuzong Emperor, Zhending sacrificed to Yan Gaoqing and Yan Zhenqing; Shaozhou added ancillary sacrifice to Zhang Jiuling's son Zheng; Yizhou to Zhuge Liang; and Xiaoshan to You Zuo and Luo Congyan.

sentences.zh: 皆歷代名臣，事蹟顯著。

translations.literal: All were famous ministers of successive ages, their deeds illustrious.
translations.idiomatic: All were renowned ministers of successive dynasties whose deeds were illustrious.

sentences.zh: 守臣題請，禮官議覆，事載實錄，年月可稽。

translations.literal: Local officials submitted requests, ritual officials deliberated and reported, matters are recorded in the Veritable Records, years and months can be verified.
translations.idiomatic: Local officials submitted petitions, ritual officers deliberated and reported, and the matters are recorded in the Veritable Records with dates that can be verified.

sentences.zh: 至若有明一代之臣抗美前史者，或以功勳，或以學行，或以直節，或以死事，臚於志乘，刻於碑版，匪一而足。

translations.literal: As for those of the Ming generation who resist comparison with earlier histories—some for merit, some for learning and conduct, some for upright integrity, some for death in service—listed in local gazetteers, carved on stele tablets, not one or two merely.
translations.idiomatic: As for ministers of the Ming who stand comparison with the great figures of earlier histories—some for merit, some for learning and conduct, some for upright integrity, some for dying in service—they are listed in local gazetteers and carved on stele tablets, and are far more than one or two.

sentences.zh: 其大者，鄱陽湖忠臣祠祀丁普郎等三十五人，南昌忠臣祠祀趙德勝等十四人，太平忠臣廟祀花雲、王鼎、許瑗，金華忠臣祠祀胡大海，皆太祖自定其典。

translations.literal: Among the greater: Poyang Lake Loyal Ministers Shrine sacrifices to Ding Pulang and thirty-five others; Nanchang Loyal Ministers Shrine to Zhao Desheng and fourteen others; Taiping Loyal Ministers Temple to Hua Yun, Wang Ding, and Xu Yuan; Jinhua Loyal Ministers Shrine to Hu Dahai—all rituals Taizu himself established.
translations.idiomatic: Among the greater cases: the Poyang Lake Loyal Ministers Shrine sacrifices to Ding Pulang and thirty-five others; the Nanchang Loyal Ministers Shrine to Zhao Desheng and fourteen others; the Taiping Loyal Ministers Temple to Hua Yun, Wang Ding, and Xu Yuan; and the Jinhua Loyal Ministers Shrine to Hu Dahai—all rites the Taizu established himself.

sentences.zh: 其後，通州祀常遇春，山海關祀徐達，蘇州祀夏原吉、周忱，淮安祀陳瑄，海州衛祀衛青、徐安生，甘州祀毛忠，榆林祀餘子俊，杭州祀于謙，蕭山祀魏驥，汀州祀王得仁，廣州祀楊信民、毛吉，雲南祀沐英、沐晟，貴州祀顧成，廬陵祀劉球、李時勉，廣信祀鄧顒，寶慶祀賀興隆，上杭祀伍驥、丁泉，慶遠祀葉禎，雲南祀王禕、吳雲，青田祀劉基，平陽祀薛瑄，杭州祀鄒濟、徐善述，金華祀章懋，皆眾著耳目，炳然可考。

translations.literal: Afterward: Tongzhou sacrificed to Chang Yuchun, Shanhai Pass to Xu Da, Suzhou to Xia Yuanji and Zhou Chen, Huai'an to Chen Xuan, Haizhou Guard to Wei Qing and Xu Ansheng, Ganzhou to Mao Zhong, Yulin to Yu Zijun, Hangzhou to Yu Qian, Xiaoshan to Wei Ji, Tingzhou to Wang Deren, Guangzhou to Yang Xinmin and Mao Ji, Yunnan to Mu Ying and Mu Sheng, Guizhou to Gu Cheng, Luling to Liu Qiu and Li Shimian, Guangxin to Deng Yong, Shaozhou to He Xinglong, Shanghang to Wu Ji and Ding Quan, Qingyuan to Ye Zhen, Yunnan to Wang Yi and Wu Yun, Qingtian to Liu Ji, Pingyang to Xue Xuan, Hangzhou to Zou Ji and Xu Shanshu, Jinhua to Zhang Mao—all plainly visible to all, brilliant and verifiable.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Tongzhou sacrificed to Chang Yuchun, Shanhai Pass to Xu Da, Suzhou to Xia Yuanji and Zhou Chen, Huai'an to Chen Xuan, Haizhou Guard to Wei Qing and Xu Ansheng, Ganzhou to Mao Zhong, Yulin to Yu Zijun, Hangzhou to Yu Qian, Xiaoshan to Wei Ji, Tingzhou to Wang Deren, Guangzhou to Yang Xinmin and Mao Ji, Yunnan to Mu Ying and Mu Sheng, Guizhou to Gu Cheng, Luling to Liu Qiu and Li Shimian, Guangxin to Deng Yong, Shaozhou to He Xinglong, Shanghang to Wu Ji and Ding Quan, Qingyuan to Ye Zhen, Yunnan again to Wang Yi and Wu Yun, Qingtian to Liu Ji, Pingyang to Xue Xuan, Hangzhou again to Zou Ji and Xu Shanshu, and Jinhua to Zhang Mao—all well known and plainly documented.

sentences.zh: 其他郡縣山川龍神忠烈之士，及祈禱有應而祀者，《會典》所載，尤詳悉云。

translations.literal: Other commanderies, counties, mountains and rivers, dragon spirits, loyal warriors, and those sacrificed to when prayer had response—the Records of Rites Canon records in especially full detail.
translations.idiomatic: Other sacrifices in commanderies and counties—to mountain and river spirits, dragon gods, loyal martyrs, and spirits answered by prayer—are recorded in especially full detail in the Collected Statutes.

sentences.zh: ○厲壇

translations.literal: ○ Altar of Wandering Ghosts
translations.idiomatic: ○ Altar of Wandering Ghosts

sentences.zh: 泰厲壇祭無祀鬼神。

translations.literal: The Great Impurity Altar sacrifices to ghosts without offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Impurity Altar sacrifices to ghosts who lack descendants to tend their rites.

sentences.zh: 《春秋傳》曰：「鬼有所歸，乃不為厲。

translations.literal: The Zuo Commentary says: "When ghosts have whither to return, they do not become impurity."
translations.idiomatic: The Zuo Commentary says, "When ghosts have a place to which they may return, they do not become wandering harm."

sentences.zh: 」此其義也。

translations.literal: " This is the principle.
translations.idiomatic: This is the principle behind the rite.

sentences.zh: 《祭法》：王祭泰厲，諸侯祭公厲，大夫祭族厲。

translations.literal: The Canon of Sacrifice: the king sacrifices to the Great Impurity, feudal lords to the Regional Impurity, great officers to the Clan Impurity.
translations.idiomatic: The Canon of Sacrifice states that the king sacrifices to the Great Impurity, feudal lords to the Regional Impurity, and great officers to the Clan Impurity.

sentences.zh: 《士喪禮》：「疾病禱於厲』，《鄭注》謂「漢時民間皆秋祠厲」，則此祀達於上下矣，然後世皆不舉行。

translations.literal: The Scholar's Mourning Rites: "In illness pray at the impurity altar"—Zheng's Commentary says "In Han times the populace all in autumn sacrificed to impurity"; thus this sacrifice reached upper and lower, yet later ages all did not perform it.
translations.idiomatic: The Scholar's Mourning Rites reads, "In illness pray at the impurity altar"; Zheng Xuan's commentary says that in Han times the common people all sacrificed to impurity in autumn—so the rite once reached from court to commoners, yet later ages ceased to perform it.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年定制，京都祭泰厲，設壇玄武湖中，歲以清明及十月朔日遣官致祭。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongwu regulations were fixed: the capital sacrifices to the Great Impurity, an altar set in Black Tortoise Lake, each year on Clear and Bright and the first day of the tenth month officials are dispatched to sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Hongwu regulations were fixed: the capital sacrificed to the Great Impurity at an altar in Black Tortoise Lake, with officials dispatched each year on Clear and Bright and the first day of the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 前期七日，檄京都城隍。

translations.literal: Seven days before, a dispatch is sent to the capital's metropolitan city god.
translations.idiomatic: Seven days beforehand a proclamation was sent to the capital's metropolitan city god.

sentences.zh: 祭日，設京省城隍神位於壇上，無祀鬼神等位於壇下之東西，羊三，豕三，飯米三石。

translations.literal: On the sacrifice day, the metropolitan and provincial city god spirit tablets are set atop the altar, tablets of ghosts without offerings and the like east and west below the altar; three sheep, three pigs, three piculs of rice.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of sacrifice the metropolitan and provincial city-god tablets were placed atop the altar, while tablets to unclaimed ghosts and the like were set east and west below it, with three sheep, three pigs, and three piculs of rice.

sentences.zh: 王國祭國厲，府州祭郡厲，縣祭邑厲，皆設壇城北，一年二祭如京師。

translations.literal: Princely states sacrifice to the state impurity, prefectures and departments to commandery impurity, counties to district impurity—all set altars north of the city, two sacrifices a year as at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Princely domains sacrificed to the state impurity, prefectures and departments to the commandery impurity, and counties to the district impurity, each with an altar north of the city wall and two annual sacrifices as at the capital.

sentences.zh: 裡社則祭鄉厲。

translations.literal: Village communities then sacrifice to township impurity.
translations.idiomatic: Village communities sacrificed to the township impurity.

sentences.zh: 後定郡邑厲、鄉厲，皆以清明日、七月十五日、十月朔日。

translations.literal: Later commandery, district, and township impurity were all fixed to Clear and Bright day, the fifteenth of the seventh month, and the first day of the tenth month.
translations.idiomatic: Later the commandery, district, and township impurity rites were all fixed to Clear and Bright, the fifteenth of the seventh month, and the first day of the tenth month.
